Eligibility Criteria for Manipur University Group B & C Posts Recruitment 2026

Section Officer:

  • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized Institute/University.
  • 3 years of experience as Senior Assistant in Level 6 or 8 years as Assistant in Level 4 in Central/State Govt./University/PSU/Autonomous Institutions or equivalent positions in reputed private companies/banks with an annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Proficiency in Computer Operation, noting, and drafting.

Senior Assistant:

  • Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institution.
  • 3 years of experience as UDC or equivalent in Level 4 in Central/State Govt./University/PSU/Autonomous Bodies or equivalent pay package in reputed private companies/corporate banks with an annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.
  • Proficiency in Typing, Computer applications, noting, and drafting.

Hindi Translator:

  • Master's Degree in Hindi with English as a compulsory or elective subject, or vice versa.
  • OR Master’s Degree in any subject with Hindi Medium and English as a compulsory/elective subject or as the medium of examination.
  • OR Recognized Diploma or Certificate course in translation from Hindi to English & vice versa or two years of translation experience in Central/State Govt. offices.
  • Studied one of the languages other than Hindi from the 8th schedule of the Constitution at the 10th level from a recognized board.
  • Technical Assistant:
  • Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years of experience in the maintenance/operation of Scientific Instruments in Laboratories.
  • Relevant subject experience in University/Research establishments/Central/State Govt./PSU/Autonomous bodies or Private organizations with an annual turnover of at least Rs. 200 Crores.

Semi-Professional Assistant:

  • Master’s Degree in Library Science or Information Science.
  • OR Bachelor’s Degree in Library/Library and Information Science with two years relevant experience in University/Research Establishment/Central/State Govt./PSU Autonomous Institutions.

Junior Stenographer:

  • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi with a minimum speed of 80 wpm.
  • Proficiency in Typing in English or Hindi with a minimum speed of 35/30 wpm.
  • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Skill Test Norms: Dictation: 10 minutes at 80 wpm, Transcription: 50 minutes English/65 minutes Hindi.

Junior Assistant:

  • Bachelor's Degree from a recognized Institute/University.
  • English Typing at 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing at 30 wpm.
  • Proficiency in Computer Operations.

Cook:

  • 10th Class from a recognized Board.
  • ITI Trade certificate in Bakery and Confectionery (1-year duration).
  • 3 years of experience in cooking/catering services in educational institutions/guest houses or 3-star hotels or similar organizations.

Laboratory Attendant:

  • 10+2 with Science stream from any recognized Central/State Board OR 10th Pass with Science as one of the subjects and skill certificate in Laboratory Technology.

Library Attendant:

  • 10+2 or its equivalent examination from a recognized Board.
  • Certificate course in Library Science from a recognized Institution.
  • One-year experience in a University/College/Educational Institution Library.
  • Basic knowledge of computer applications.

Peon/MTS:

  • 10th Pass from a recognized Board OR ITI Pass.

  • 10th Pass from a recognized Board OR ITI Pass.

  • 10th Pass from a recognized Board OR ITI Pass.

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • A candidate must be able to speak Manipuri, Meitei/Meetei Ion or any of the Tribal Dialects of Manipur.
  • A candidate must be a permanent resident of Manipur. Provided that a candidate whose parent or any of his/her ancestors in his/her direct lineage are/were permanent resident of the State, (with proper documentary proof like enrolment in the Electoral Roll and Birth Certificate) then he/she will also be eligible.
  • The date of birth shall be as entered in the Matriculate/High School Leaving Certificate or Secondary School Leaving Certificate or in a certificate recognised by the Indian University as equivalent to Matriculation or in an extract from a Register of Matriculates maintained by a University which extract must be certified by the proper authority of the University or in the Higher secondary or an equivalent examination certificate. No other document relating to age like horoscope, affidavits birth extracts from Municipal Corporation, Service Records and the like will be accepted.
  • Submission of application in any other mode will not be entertained. All applicants should be in possession of the requisite certificates/documents as on the closing date for submission of the online application, i.e. 28th February, 2026.

  • For the Applicants in whose case payments details have not been received from the bank, they will be treated as fictitious payment cases and their applications will be rejected in the first instance. A list of such applicants shall be made available on the Commissions website after the last date of online application. On receipt of documentary proof, genuine fee payment cases will be considered, and their applications will be revived, if they are otherwise eligible.
  • All candidates in service shall submit/upload the “NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE” duly issued by the concerned Department/Authority.
  • The decision of the Commission as to the eligibility or otherwise of a candidate shall be final. If on verification at any stage of the recruitment or after the recruitment, it is found that a candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility condition, his/her candidature for the Examination will be cancelled by the Commission.
  • The Plan of Examination, Syllabus and venue for Written Examination and Interview will be notified in due course.

How to Apply

  • The online application should be applied at www.empsconline.gov.in w.e.f. 7th February, 2026 to 05:30 PM of 28th February, 2026 after which the link will be disabled.
  • Applications must be submitted online at www.empsconline.gov.in.
  • The application window is open from February 7, 2026, to February 28, 2026, at 05:30 PM.
  • Other submission modes are not accepted.
  • Applicants must possess all required documents by the closing date, February 28, 2026.

4. Professional Assistant (1 Post)

  • Bachelor's Degree in Library/Library & Information Science with 3 years experience in relevant field
  • Knowledge of Computer Applications
  • Age: 35 years

5. Upper Division Clerk (UDC) (6 Posts)

  • 2 years experience as Lower Division Clerk (LDC) in University/Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies or reputed private companies

6. Lower Division Clerk (LDC) (16 Posts)

  • Bachelor's Degree from recognized institute/university

Post Category General/OBC Candidates SC/ST/PwBD Candidates
College Librarian Rs. 3,000/- Rs. 1,500/-

Important: Fee payment is online only through the portal. Separate fee required for each post if applying for multiple posts. Fee is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Online Application Portal Opening 28-01-2026 (Wednesday)
Online Application Closing 27-02-2026 (Friday) 11:30 PM IST
Hard Copy Submission Deadline 10-03-2026 (Monday) 6:00 PM IST
Examination/Selection Process To be announced on CSU website

Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of Applications: Initial screening based on eligibility criteria and submitted documents
  • Written Examination/OMR Test: For applicable posts (pattern to be announced)
  • Skill Test: Typing test for LDC/UDC and other relevant skill assessments
  • Document Verification: Original certificates to be verified
  • Interview: Where applicable, as per CSU procedures
  • Merit-Based Selection: Final selection on merit within each zone

How to Apply

  • Visit the official CSU recruitment portal: https://csu.co.in/adarsh_nt/
  • Register with your email ID and mobile number
  • Fill the online application form with accurate details
  • Select your preferred zone and institution from the available options
  • Choose examination centre (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, or Chennai)
  • For multiple posts: Apply separately if choosing different post categories or zones, paying individual fees for each
  • Upload required documents (as mentioned in portal)
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online
  • Submit the online application
  • After online submission, send a duly signed hard copy of the application along with self-attested copies of supporting documents to:
    The Registrar
    Central Sanskrit University
    56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri
    New Delhi - 110058
    Latest by 10-03-2026 at 6:00 PM IST by registered post
  • Preserve application receipt and printout for future reference

Required Documents (Hard Copy)

  • Duly signed hard copy of online application form
  • Self-attested copies of all supporting documents:
  • • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • • Experience certificates
  • • Proof of date of birth
  • • Government-issued photo ID proof
  • • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) if applicable
  • • No Objection Certificate from current employer (if government employee)
  • • NET/SLET/SET certificate (for College Librarian post)
  • Publication list (for applicable posts)

Important Instructions

  • Dual Requirement: Both online submission AND hard copy must reach by specified deadlines. Applications failing either requirement will be rejected
  • Multiple Applications: Candidates can apply for different post categories but only ONE per category per zone. Applying for same post in different zones is NOT allowed for same category
  • Examination Centres: Available at Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai. Candidates may choose any centre regardless of zone applied
  • Eligibility Date: Criteria reckoned as on 27-02-2026 (application closing date)
  • Document Verification: Original certificates must be produced at the time of verification/interview
  • Disqualification Grounds:
  • • Incomplete applications
  • • Incorrect/mismatched information
  • • Signature/photograph variations
  • • Non-payment or incorrect fee payment
  • • Late receipt of hard copy (after 10-03-2026)
  • • False/fake certificates
  • • Use of unfair means in examination
  • Employed Candidates: Must submit No Objection Certificate from employer in hard copy at document verification
  • PwBD Candidates: Must inform about required assistance at least 10 days before examination
  • No TA/DA: Candidates bear own travel expenses for examination/interview
  • Merit-Based Selection: Mere fulfillment of qualifications does not guarantee selection
  • CSU reserves right to cancel, modify, or withdraw vacancy at any stage
  • Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification
  • No interim inquiries entertained; updates available only on CSU website
  • Territorial jurisdiction: Delhi High Court for any legal disputes

Zone-wise Recruitment Details

Candidates can apply in only ONE zone for each post category. However, candidates are free to choose different zones for different post categories. For example, a candidate can apply for LDC in Zone-1 and UDC in Zone-3, but cannot apply for LDC in both Zone-1 and Zone-3.

Zone Definition: Zones are designed for institutional stability and continuity. There is no domicile restriction—any candidate can apply to any zone. Selected candidates will be allotted to institutions within their chosen zone based on merit and preference.

Examination Details

  • Scheme of examination and syllabus available at: https://sanskrit.nic.in/uploads/2026_01_05_CSU_NT_Scheme_of_Examination_r.pdf
  • Detailed examination pattern, selection criteria, and interview schedule will be announced on CSU website

  5. Fill personal, educational, and professional details carefully and select the post/level you are applying for.
  6. Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and relevant certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  7. Pay the application fee online (category-wise fee will be mentioned in the notification) and submit the form.

  • BPSC will publish the TRE 4.0 result and merit list on bpsc.bih.nic.in after evaluating answer sheets.

(D.T./D.H.) (i.e., Diploma in Dairy Technology / Dairy Husbandry) with two years of work experience in the relevant field, along with a related proof certificate. Age Limit

Other Conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Samastipur district and of good character, and must not have been convicted by any court or have any pending criminal/civil case.

Vacancy Details & Eligibility Criteria

Post Name / Area Total Posts Eligibility Criteria
Para Legal Volunteer – Samastipur 50 Indian citizen (male/female/third gender), Matric (10th pass), resident of Samastipur district, interested in voluntary social service and legal awareness; persons like teachers (including retired), retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, NGO/club members, SHG members, Jeevika/mitra group members and other individuals (except advocates) may apply.
Para Legal Volunteer – Rosera 25 Same eligibility as above; selection will be done on area-wise basis so that PLVs can work in villages or group of villages of Rosera subdivision.
Para Legal Volunteer – Dalsingsarai 25 Same eligibility as above for Dalsingsarai area; preference to applicants willing to work at grassroots village level.
Para Legal Volunteer – Patori 25 Same eligibility as above for Patori area.
125 Para Legal Volunteers  

Reservation: As this is a voluntary, non-salaried position and not a government job recruitment, no reservation roster is applied to the posts; however, adequate representation will be given to all sections of society as per the scheme, and the panel will be valid for one year.

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum educational qualification: Matric (10th pass).
  • Preference to candidates actively engaged in social service, legal awareness, community activities, SHGs, NGOs, etc.
  • Advocates are not eligible to apply for PLV positions.
  • Previously selected Para Legal Volunteers may also apply again.

Roles and Responsibilities of Para Legal Volunteers

  • To create legal awareness in their area and work as a bridge between victims in need of legal aid and the District Legal Services Authority.
  • To assist in legal aid work at the DLSA office and Legal Aid Centres as and when directed.
  • To participate actively in legal awareness camps and outreach programmes organized by DLSA.
  • To perform any other legal services work assigned by the District Legal Services Authority under NALSA PLV Scheme.

Honorarium & Allowances

Daily Honorarium Rs. 750/- per day under NALSA PLV Scheme (PLV) for those specific days on which DLSA assigns special work or when the PLV brings a person from the village for legal aid / ADR centre or actively participates in legal awareness camps.
Other Allowances No additional allowance of any kind is payable apart from the above honorarium.
Nature of Service Voluntary service only; this is not a regular government post and does not confer any right to government employment.

Selection Process

The advertisement mainly lays down eligibility, instructions and application procedure; selection of PLVs will be done by District Legal Services Authority, Samastipur as per NALSA PLV Scheme guidelines.

  • Scrutiny of applications submitted in prescribed format along with required documents.
  • Preparation of shortlist/panel on the basis of eligibility, local residence, social service interest and other criteria fixed by DLSA.
  • Issue of interview call letter (interview letter format is enclosed in the notification) to shortlisted candidates.
  • Interview and interaction at DLSA Samastipur for final selection.
  • Preparation of final panel of PLVs; panel period will be valid for one year.

How to Apply for Samastipur DLSA Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026

  1. Download or obtain the prescribed application form for Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) as annexed with the advertisement.
  2. Fill the application form completely in Hindi/English, providing all required personal, educational and contact details.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates (Matric), other qualification/experience certificates, and a clear photocopy of Aadhaar card.
  4. Attach a declaration/affidavit stating that no criminal or civil case is pending against you and you have not been convicted by any court.
  5. Affix a self-attested passport size photograph at the designated place on the application form.
  6. Place the application form and enclosures in an envelope, write your complete address on a self-addressed envelope with adequate registered postage stamps for correspondence.
  7. Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post/Ordinary Post or submit by hand to the office of the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Samastipur, so that it reaches on or before 09 March 2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  8. Applications received after the last date or found incomplete/incorrect are liable to be rejected without any information.
  9. Mention your mobile/WhatsApp number clearly in the application form for communication regarding interview, etc.

Important Instructions

  • The applicant must be an Indian citizen and a resident of Samastipur district.
  • The applicant should be physically and mentally healthy, of good character and interested in social service.
  • No candidate should have been convicted by any court, and no criminal or civil case should be pending against them; a declaration/affidavit to this effect must be attached.
  • Applications received after 09 March 2026 (5:30 PM) will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Any deficiency/error in the application form may lead to rejection of the application without notice.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly visit the Samastipur district website ecourt.gov.in/samastipur to get updated information related to this advertisement, interview dates and other notices.
  • This is a voluntary, non-salaried engagement; it does not give any right to regular employment in any government department.

CSBC Bihar Police Constable (Operator) Eligibility Criteria

Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen.

Selection in three stages:

  1. Written Exam:

    • Shot Put: 16 lb to 15 ft (males); 12 lb to 8 ft (females).
    • Up to 3 attempts per event.
    • Physical measurements checked; failure disqualifies.
    • No marks; must pass all events.
  3. Document Verification:
    • Verify education, age, reservation certificates.
    • Originals required; failure leads to disqualification.

Final merit based on written exam marks (tie-breakers: age, higher qualification, alphabetical name order).

Medical exam and character verification before appointment.

  • Physics subject is mandatory in B.Sc degree

Essential Qualifications

  • Must be an Indian citizen
  • Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) degree with Physics from recognized university is compulsory
  • General category candidates must have secured minimum 50% marks in B.Sc
  • Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates must have secured minimum 45% marks in B.Sc

  • Annual increments and other service benefits as per Bihar Police rules will be applicable
  • Medical facilities and other welfare benefits as per government norms

  • For Unreserved (General) Category Male Candidates: Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 37 years
  • For Unreserved (General) Category Female Candidates: Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 40 years
  • For Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class (Male & Female): Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 40 years
  • For Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (Male & Female): Minimum age 21 years and Maximum age 42 years
  • Age Relaxation for Bihar Government Employees: 05 years relaxation for those seeking promotion to higher pay scale through competitive examination, provided they have completed minimum three years of regular service
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: 03 years plus the period of defense service, provided actual age on cut-off date does not exceed 57 years
  • Age calculation will be based on date of birth mentioned in Matriculation or equivalent examination certificate
  • The cut-off date for age calculation is 01/08/2025

Application Fee

  • For All Category Candidates (Male/Female/Third Gender): Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Payment mode: Online only through Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card, or UPI
  • No other payment mode will be accepted
  • Bank charges for online transaction will be borne by the candidates
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances
  • Candidates are advised to exercise caution while making payment and avoid multiple payments for single application
  • If amount is deducted due to electricity or internet failure or slow bank link and registration is not completed, the fee will be refunded by Payment Gateway after 07 working days
  • In case of charge back request from bank after successful registration, the application will be rejected and legal action will be initiated
  • BPSSC will not charge any amount other than the application fee mentioned above

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination: One paper of 100 marks consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions with 2 hours duration. 40 questions from General Knowledge and Current Affairs, 60 questions from Physics at graduation level. Minimum 30% marks required to qualify. Candidates scoring 20 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for Main Examination based on merit
  • Stage 2 - Main Examination: Consists of two papers:
    • Paper I - General Language Knowledge: 100 marks (50 marks General Hindi + 50 marks General English) of Intermediate level. Objective multiple choice questions. Duration: 1.5 hours. Minimum 30 marks required to qualify. Marks will not be added to merit
    • Paper II - Graduate Level Physics: 100 marks consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions. Duration: 3 hours. Minimum 33% marks required to qualify. Based on marks in this paper, candidates up to 5 times the number of vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for Physical Efficiency Test
  • Negative Marking: 0.2 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer in both stages
  • Stage 3 - Physical Efficiency Test: Qualifying nature (no marks awarded). All tests must be passed separately:
    • Running: Male candidates (all categories): 1 mile (1.6 km) in maximum 7 minutes. Female candidates (all categories): 1 km in maximum 7 minutes
    • High Jump: Male: Minimum 3 feet 6 inches. Female: Minimum 2 feet 6 inches
    • Long Jump: Male: Minimum 10 feet. Female: Minimum 7 feet
    • Shot Put: Male: 16 pounds shot - Minimum 14 feet. Female: 12 pounds shot - Minimum 8 feet
  • Maximum three attempts will be given for High Jump, Long Jump and Shot Put
  • Failure to achieve minimum standard in any of the four events will result in disqualification
  • Final Merit List: Based on marks obtained in Main Examination Paper II (Physics), successful candidates in Physical Efficiency Test will be selected as per number of vacancies category-wise
  • In case of normalization required due to multi-session/multi-paper examinations, Equi-Percentile Method will be used
  • Medical examination, character verification and background verification will be conducted by appointing authority before final appointment

Physical Measurement Standards

  • Height Requirements:
    • Unreserved and Backward Class Male Candidates: Minimum 165 cm
    • Extremely Backward Class, Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Male Candidates: Minimum 160 cm
    • Female Candidates (All Categories): Minimum 155 cm
  • Chest Measurement (For Male Candidates Only):
    • Unreserved, Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class Male: Unexpanded - 81 cm (minimum), Expanded - 86 cm (minimum). Minimum 5 cm expansion compulsory
    • Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Male: Unexpanded - 79 cm (minimum), Expanded - 84 cm (minimum). Minimum 5 cm expansion compulsory
    • No chest measurement for female candidates
  • Weight: Female candidates (all categories): Minimum 48 kg
  • For Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender (Third Gender): Gender determination will be done as per identification card issued by District Magistrate under Section 6 of Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2020 in Form-3. Category will be determined accordingly

General Information/Instructions

  • Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission (BPSSC) is conducting recruitment for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation) posts in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless), Bihar, Patna
  • Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Male, Female and Third Gender candidates can apply
  • Reservation will be applicable as per Bihar Reservation of Vacancies in Posts and Services (for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes) Act, 1991 (Bihar Act 3, 1992) as amended from time to time
  • Women Reservation: 35% horizontal reservation for women in each reservation category (keeping intact 3% reservation for Backward Class women). This 35% horizontal reservation is admissible only to original residents of Bihar State as per General Administration Department resolution dated 09/07/2025. However, as per Section 4(3) of Bihar Act 3, 1992, women can also be appointed on merit basis in addition to 35% reservation
  • Freedom Fighters' Descendants: 2% horizontal reservation for grandchildren (grandson/granddaughter) of Bihar State freedom fighters who have been granted pension by Central Government as per General Administration Department resolution dated 03/09/2015. Selected candidates will be counted in their respective reserved/unreserved category
  • EWS Reservation: Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections as per Bihar Reservation in Vacancies in Posts and Services (for Economically Weaker Sections) Act, 2019. Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2024-25 will be acceptable
  • Transgender Reservation: Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender (Third Gender) are included at serial number 47 in Schedule-2 of backward classes list. They will get benefit of reservation applicable to backward classes as per General Administration Department resolution dated 12/09/2014
  • Benefit of reservation applicable only to original residents of Bihar State. Candidates from other states belonging to reserved categories will be treated as unreserved category candidates
  • Candidates working in State/Central Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or produce No Objection Certificate at the time of selection
  • During written examination and physical efficiency test, candidates must follow social distancing and all latest instructions issued by administration for prevention from Corona infection
  • Admit card for written examination will be issued online. Information will be provided through newspapers and commission website. Important information may be sent through SMS/E-mail
  • Normally 06 months time may be required to complete selection process. Candidates are advised to ensure their availability for written examination, physical efficiency test and document verification. Request for time extension will not be accepted under any circumstances (family, personal, medical, bone fracture, pregnancy etc.)
  • The appointing authority for Assistant Sub-Inspector (Operation) post is Deputy Inspector General of Police (Wireless and Technical Services)
  • Before final appointment, medical examination, character and antecedents verification of all selected candidates will be conducted by appointing authority as per prescribed rules
  • Candidates must be free from such diseases, structural defects or physical weakness which make them unfit for duties
  • Medical examination will include tests for vision defects, color blindness, hearing power, stammering, flat foot, knocking knee etc. Being found fit in medical examination is mandatory for appointment
  • Candidates with stammering or stuttering defects will not be eligible for selection
  • BPSSC reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process or change any terms and conditions without further notice or assigning any reason at any stage
  • In case of any discrepancy found in Hindi version of advertisement, English version will prevail

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through BPSSC website https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in
  • Click on "Bihar Police" tab on the website and then click on Advertisement No. 04/2026 link
  • Online application start date: 04/02/2026
  • Online application last date: 04/03/2026
  • No other mode of application will be accepted
  • Before registration and payment, keep a valid and active mobile number and email ID which should preferably be registered in your name
  • Mobile number and email ID are mandatory for registration
  • If you don't have your own email ID, please create one as important information will be shared on your email ID and mobile phone during application and selection process
  • Commission will communicate with candidate on the same mobile number/email ID provided during registration till completion of final stage of recruitment
  • Commission will not be responsible for wrong, invalid or disconnected mobile number or email ID
  • Application Process - Part 1 (Registration):
    • First registration of candidate will be done where information like name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, Bihar State domicile, reservation category, gender and date of birth will be taken
    • After registration, payment process must be completed
    • After successful registration, Registration Number and Password will be sent immediately through SMS/E-mail to candidate's mobile phone and email ID

    • If you have registered with wrong details, you can use "Cancel Registration Form" provision to cancel your registration after payment. However, previously paid application fee will not be refunded and you will have to pay application fee again for new registration
  • Application Process - Part 2 (Final Submission):
    • After successful registration, login with provided Registration Number and Password
    • Fill required information like father's/husband's name, mother's name, address, educational qualification etc. correctly and give consent on declaration
    • Upload scanned recent color photograph (within 2 months old, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)
    • Upload signature separately in English and Hindi (in black or blue ink, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif format)
    • If instructions regarding photo and signature are not followed, online application will be rejected/cancelled
    • After uploading photo and signature, candidates can edit details by clicking "Edit Details" button before final submission
    • Once confirmed and submitted, application details cannot be edited
    • After submission, confirmation message (SMS/E-mail) will be received on registered mobile number/email ID
    • Print acknowledgement of submitted application on A4 size paper and keep it safely for future correspondence
  • Only one mobile number can be used for one application only
  • Only one application per candidate is allowed. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, all applications will be rejected
  • Candidates applying with fake name and address will be disqualified and strict legal action will be taken
  • Candidates should mention date of birth exactly as per matriculation/equivalent board examination certificate
  • Candidates should fill name, father's/husband's name, address and all other information correctly. If any discrepancy is found during certificate verification, candidature will be cancelled
  • If wrong reservation category is entered in application, candidature will be cancelled
  • Reserved category candidates are advised to obtain detailed information about their category/caste/class from General Administration Department, Bihar Government website state.bihar.gov.in
  • There is no need to send filled online application to BPSSC, however Registration Number is required for future correspondence. Keep printout of acknowledgement (with photo) safely
  • No extension will be given in last date of online application. Request for correction received through post or other means will not be considered
  • Exercise caution while making online payment and avoid multiple payments for single application
  • Payment of application fee through online mode is mandatory
  • For any guidance on filling application and information regarding advertisement, contact Mobile Number: Not specified in working days

  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit

  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above.   • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same.   • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) has released an official notification for the recruitment of 01 Junior Research Fellow Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official NIT Silchar website. The last date to submit the application form is 05-03-2026. In this article, you’ll find the NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

NIT Silchar Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Institute National Institute of Technology (NIT) Silchar, Assam
Status Institute of National Importance
Department Physics
Position Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Number of Posts 1 (One)
Research Project Title Quantum Dots integrated titania with plenty of heterojunctions and its utility for green hydrogen production: Beyond Proof of Concept
Funding Agency CSIR (Council of Scientific and Industrial Research)
Project Sanction Number 80/0099/24/EMR-II
Principal Investigator Dr. Ranjith G. Nair, Associate Professor
Contract Duration 3 Years
Fellowship ₹37,000/month
Application Deadline 05-03-2026
Interview Mode Online/Offline (to be decided by the Institute)
Advertisement Number NITS/Dean(R&C)/Physic/705/01/2026
Official Website www.nits.ac.in
Trending Govt Jobs
  • IAF Agniveer New Recruitment 2026
  • UPSC CSE Online Form 2026
  • DSSSB 911 AE, JE & More Online Form 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026
  • MCL 677 Various Vacancies Online Form 2026

About the Research Project

The research project focuses on "Quantum Dots integrated titania with plenty of heterojunctions and its utility for green hydrogen production: Beyond Proof of Concept". This cutting-edge project aims to develop advanced nanomaterials and photocatalytic systems for sustainable hydrogen production, which is crucial for clean energy solutions. The selected JRF will be involved in synthesis, characterization, and testing of quantum dots and titania-based heterojunctions for photocatalytic applications.

Job Description

  • Synthesis of Quantum Dots and Titania nanomaterials
  • Development of metal oxide heterojunctions
  • Fabrication of photocatalytic reactors
  • Testing and evaluation for green hydrogen generation
  • Literature review and data analysis
  • Technical report writing and publication support
  • Laboratory maintenance and safety compliance

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: Any one of the following:
    • B.S. (4-year programme) with 55% marks minimum
    • B. Pharmacy (B. Pharm) with 55% marks minimum
    • MBBS with 55% marks minimum
    • Integrated BS-MS programme with 55% marks minimum
    • M.Sc. with 55% marks minimum
    • Bachelor of Engineering (BE) with 55% marks minimum
    • B.Tech. or equivalent degree with 55% marks minimum
  • Competitive Examinations: Must have passed either NET (National Eligibility Test) OR GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
  • Percentage Criteria: Minimum 55% marks in the qualifying examination (45% for SC/ST/PwD candidates)

Desirable Qualifications

  • M.Sc. Physics with specialization in relevant field
  • Experience in Nanomaterials Synthesis and Characterization
  • Knowledge of photocatalytic techniques
  • Laboratory experience in material science
  • Published research papers or conference presentations

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age Limit: 28 years as on the date of application (05-03-2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to:
    • SC (Scheduled Caste)
    • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
    • OBC (Other Backward Class)
    • WOMEN candidates
    • PwD (Person with Disability) candidates
  • Calculation: Age will be calculated as on 05-03-2026 (Application deadline date)

Fellowship & Remuneration

  • Monthly Fellowship: ₹37,000/month
  • Nature of Remuneration: Fixed monthly fellowship on contractual basis
  • Duration: 3 years (subject to satisfactory performance)
  • Basis: CSIR norms for JRF fellowship

How to Apply

  1. Download the prescribed application form from the official notification PDF or NIT Silchar website
  2. Fill the application form legibly with all required information
  3. Prepare a comprehensive CV highlighting academic achievements and research interests
  4. Gather all required supporting documents (certificates, marksheets, exam scores, etc.)
  5. Scan all documents clearly (application form, CV, and documents)
  6. Prepare an email with the subject line: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  7. Attach all scanned documents to the email
  8. Send the email to the Principal Investigator: [email protected]
  9. Application submission deadline: 05-03-2026

Required Documents

  • Duly filled application form (prescribed format)
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) - comprehensive and detailed
  • Educational certificates and marksheets from Class X onwards
  • NET/GATE Admit Card and Scorecard/Certificate (mandatory)
  • Bachelor's degree certificate and official transcripts
  • Master's degree certificate and official transcripts (if applicable)
  • Character certificate from college/institution principal
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates (if applicable)
  • Disability certificate for PwD candidates (if applicable)
  • Proof of age (Birth certificate or School leaving certificate)
  • Copy of national-level ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport)
  • Research papers or publications (if any)

Selection Process

  1. Application Screening: All applications will be reviewed against eligibility criteria
  2. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on academic performance and NET/GATE scores
  3. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (mode to be communicated)
  4. Interview Focus: Subject knowledge, research interest, aptitude for research
  5. Final Selection: Based on interview performance and overall merit
  6. Agreement Signing: Selected candidates must sign the JRF agreement at the time of joining

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Employment Type: Temporary, contractual, time-bound project position
  • Duration: 3 years (May be extended based on project progress and performance)
  • Reporting: To the Principal Investigator (Dr. Ranjith G. Nair), Department of Physics
  • No Objection Certificate: Employed candidates must submit NOC from their employer at the time of interview
  • Institute Rights: The Institute reserves the right to:
    • Restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on screening
    • Not recruit if suitable candidates are not found
    • Modify project duration based on funding or progress
  • Agreement Binding: Selected candidates must sign a JRF agreement before joining
  • Compliance: Must adhere to all NIT Silchar rules, regulations, and CSIR guidelines

Important Instructions

  • Ensure all information in the application form is accurate and true
  • Double-check that copies of all certificates are scanned clearly and legibly
  • Keep NET/GATE scorecard ready as it is mandatory documentation
  • Email subject line must be exact: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  • Do not miss the application deadline - no late applications will be accepted
  • Use official email only ([email protected])
  • Interview date and mode will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates
  • Attend interview on specified date and time (important for selection)
  • The Institute decision is final and binding

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Written Examination (19th July, 2026)
    • Paper-I: General Ability and Intelligence - 250 Marks
      • Duration: 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
      • Type: Objective (Multiple Choice) Type questions
      • Medium: English as well as Hindi
      • Subjects: General Mental Ability (logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, numerical ability, data interpretation), General Science, Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography
      • There will be penalty (Negative Marking) for wrong answers: One third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
    • Paper-II: General Studies, Essay and Comprehension - 200 Marks
      • Duration: 3 hours (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM)
      • Type: Conventional (Descriptive) Type
      • Part-A: Essay questions (80 Marks) - to be answered in long narrative form either in Hindi or English. Topics: modern Indian history especially freedom struggle, geography, polity and economy, security and human rights issues, analytical ability
      • Part-B: Comprehension, précis writing, other communications/language skills (120 Marks) - to be attempted in English only. Topics: Comprehension passages, précis writing, developing counter arguments, simple grammar and other language testing aspects
      • Candidates must write answers only in the medium allowed. No credit for answers written in other medium
    • There will be minimum qualifying marks separately in each Paper as may be fixed by the Commission
    • Paper-I will be evaluated first and Paper-II will be evaluated only for those who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I
  • Stage 2: Physical Standards Tests (PST) / Physical Efficiency Tests (PET)
    • Conducted for candidates qualified in Written Examination
    • Physical Standards Requirements:
      • Men: Height 165 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) with 5 cm minimum expansion, Weight 50 kg
      • Women: Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg
      • Height and chest measurement will be measured correct to one decimal in centimeter
      • Weight should be as per height and age as per prescribed chart
    • Physical Efficiency Tests:
      • Men: 100 Meter Race in 16 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 3 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.5 Meters (3 Chances), Shot Put (7.26 Kg) 4.5 Meters (3 Chances)
      • Women: 100 Meter Race in 18 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 4 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.0 Meters (3 Chances)
    • Female candidates must submit self-declaration about pregnancy status before PST/PET
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test
    • Only for candidates qualified in PST/PET
    • Marks: 150 Marks
    • Conducted by Union Public Service Commission
    • Candidates declared unqualified in PET will not be called for Interview
    • NCC 'B' or 'C' Certificate holders will be given consideration at Interview stage
  • Stage 4: Medical Standards Tests (MST)
    • Conducted only for candidates who appeared in Interview/Personality Test
    • Detailed Medical Standards prescribed for Eye Sight, Ear, Nose, Neck, Teeth, General Health, etc.
    • Eye Sight: Better eye 6/6 or 6/9 (corrected), Worse eye 6/12 or 6/9 (corrected), Near Vision N6/N9 (corrected), Colour Perception CP-III by ISIHARA plates
    • LASIK surgery correction permitted subject to prescribed criteria
    • Candidates declared 'UNFIT' can appear before Review Medical Board preferably next day of DME
    • Appeals against MST results must be made within 24 hours after declaration of DME results
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Final Selection/Merit:
    • Merit list drawn on basis of marks obtained in Written Examination and Interview/Personality Test
    • Any candidate found not satisfying prescribed Medical Standards after MST will not be appointed
    • Tie Breaking Principle: (i) Higher marks in written total, (ii) Higher marks in Paper-I, (iii) Senior in age, (iv) At Commission's discretion

Vacancy Details

Position Number of vacancies
Research Associate III (RA III) 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification: Ph.D. in Physics or equivalent degree with minimum 75% marks or 7.5 CGPA during Ph.D. (graduate) and above 6.0 CGPA (or equivalent percentage of 60%) during M.Sc./B.E/B.Tech./M.E/M.Tech. coursework. Relaxation: 7.0 CGPA or 70% for OBC/EWS, 6.5 CGPA or 65% for SC/ST/PWD.
  • Desired Experience: Good knowledge of more than one of the following topics at the M.Sc. Physics and PhD level: Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics, Electronics, Quantum Mechanics, Quantum Optics, Electromagnetic Theory, Atomic and laser spectroscopy, Finite Element Modelling and Simulation using COMSOL/ANSYS, Knowledge of ORCAD/EAGLE, Hands on experimental exposure in AMOP (Atomic, Molecular, and Optical Physics) experiments at the PhD level.
  • Ph.D. in Physics. Candidates who have submitted/ defended their Ph.D. thesis and are waiting for final degree can also apply.
  • Must have worked for at least one year at the RAI/RAIII level.
  • Experience in programming with any one of the following: Python/MATLAB/ Mathematica / VHDL/ Verilog/ LabVIEW/ SolidWorks / COMSOL/ ANSYS/ digital & analog electronics/ optics/ fabrication will be useful.
  • Prior demonstrated experience of working in experimental optics and/or experimental atomic and molecular physics.
  • Prior demonstrated experience with precision laser spectroscopy/ laser cooling/ ion trapping/ atom trapping and related areas.
  • Prior demonstrated experience with modelling of light-matter interaction in warm atomic vapor/cold atom/ion trap systems.
  • Demonstrated theoretical ability to model and simulate physics of cold atom/warm vapor quantum memories/repeaters/ etc.
  • Having at-least one original research paper in SCI and or a peer-reviewed journal. Preference shall be given to candidates with more than one publication in a SCI indexed journal.
  • Must be willing to work efficiently in a team environment with other students, research and project staff and postdoctoral fellows, self-motivated, and work under a variety of challenging research conditions.
  • Must have good oral and written communication skills evident through peer-reviewed publications and presentation of work in national/international conferences/workshops/school/meetings/etc.
  • Experience with supervision of PhD/Masters students
  • Exceptional candidates with a very strong publication record having only a theoretical background in light-matter interaction in warm atomic vapor/cold atom/ion trap systems and/or physics of cold atom/warm vapor quantum memories/repeaters/etc. will be considered for this opening subject to fulfilling of the criteria. Such candidates will need to provide an additional letter of recommendation/reference from their previous academic supervisors who may comment on the candidate’s academic and research potential as well as their intellectual output and abilities.
  • Must demonstrate highest work ethics, commitment and dedication to the project.

Salary/ Stipend

  • INR 67000/- + HRA as applicable (9% for Tirupati city)

Age Limit

  • Not more than 36 years

Important Dates

Notification Date 20 February 2026
Application Last date 6 March 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on CV, SOP, motivation letter, research proposal and the LORs received.
  • Online interview of the shortlisted candidates.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for the shortlisted/selected candidates.
  • Candidate needs to join duty within 7 days of intimation of selection by the committee.

General Information/ Instructions

  • Research and development
  • Design and development of laser spectroscopy set-up
  • Data recording and documentation of the research work
  • Critical analysis of the experimental results
  • Assist in any other associated experiment
  • Offline on campus physical presence is needed
  • Remote work not possible
  • Supervision and mentoring of research students and interns
  • Attending meetings, workshops, conferences
  • Reporting of experimental data, observations and outcomes in the nature of peer-reviewed manuscripts
  • Teaching responsibilities and supervision of undergraduate and postgraduate students
  • The selected candidate will get opportunity to work on interdisciplinary areas those are required for setting up of the experiment. Some of these are (but not limited to) simulation; designing, fabrication, testing of indigenous instruments in the field of lasers & optics, developing low-noise analog & digital electronics, developing FPGA based systems, ultra-high vacuum, mechanical & software development, neutral atom trapping and so on. Apart from the development of the experiment, they will have to work on simulation and modeling of physics problems that are necessary to meet the experimental goals using open source and/or proprietary software. Developing a complete experiment involves multiple work-packages and developing those requires expertise in interdisciplinary fields. Within a lab, this can be achieved by working in collaborative manner.
  • The work shall involve laser cooling techniques applied to neutral rubidium (Rb) atoms. It will also involve precision laser spectroscopy, experimental quantum optics and applications of quantum information processing protocols. The final objective is to develop a cold atom quantum memory node for quantum repeater applications.
  • Any other requirement/ Supporting material required: 1. Self-attested academic certificates and transcripts from undergraduate level to postgraduate level. 2. A copy of the current CV, a copy of the Statement of purpose (SOP) and motivation letter. 3. A brief research proposal on cold atom quantum memory. 4. Two letters of recommendation required one of which must be from your thesis supervisor (PhD research guide). 5. In case of exceptional candidates as mentioned above, three letters of recommendation are required one of which must be from your thesis supervisor (PhD research guide).
  • The shortlisted candidates will be informed by email only. Selection will be based on the qualification, experience, and interview. No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates appearing for an interview online or offline. The interview date will be notified to the shortlisted candidates by Email. For any queries send mail to [email protected]
  • IIT Tirupati also reserves the right to discontinue the position with 1 month notice if the performance is not satisfactory.

How to Apply

  • Please send all documents and supporting material as a single pdf file before the last date to the following email address: [email protected]
  • Please mark a copy of the application to [email protected].
  • Please highlight in the email subject: Application for RAIII position under the NQM project on quantum repeaters at IIT Tirupati.

Pay Scale Rs. 8,800/- to Rs. 21,000/- per month (fixed contract honorarium, post-wise)

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected through the following stages:

  1. Scrutiny of online applications and eligibility check
  2. Written Test and/or Skill Test (candidates up to 5–10 times the number of vacancies will be called, as per notified ratio)
  3. Preparation of merit list based on educational qualification percentage, written/skill test marks and experience marks
  4. Document Verification
  5. Final Selection List and Waiting List preparation

For many posts, merit will be prepared by combining educational percentage (60–65% weight), written/skill test marks (20 marks) and experience marks (up to 10–15 marks). Securing at least 30% of the total marks in the written/skill test (i.e., 6 out of 20) is mandatory for qualification.

  1. Visit the official Bilaspur district website: www.bilaspur.gov.in.
  2. Open the link related to “NHM Contract Recruitment 2025-26” under the recruitment/notice section.
  3. Read the detailed advertisement and general instructions carefully and ensure your eligibility.
  4. Fill the online application form with all required personal, educational and experience details.
  5. Upload scanned copies of necessary documents such as educational certificates, registration certificates, caste certificate, domicile certificate, disability certificate (if applicable) and experience certificates.
  6. Pay the application fee online, if applicable, as per instructions on the portal.
  7. Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference and document verification.

Important Notes

  • All appointments and selection process will be subject to the final orders of Hon’ble Supreme Court of India in SLP (C) No. 19668/2022.
  • Only online applications submitted within the stipulated time will be accepted; applications received through any other mode will be rejected.
  • Candidates must be local residents of Chhattisgarh; candidates from other states will be considered only if local candidates are not available.
  • Candidates must present all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies at the time of document verification, failing which the selection will be cancelled.
  • The contract period will initially be up to 31 March 2026 and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and NHM approval; contractual posts will automatically cease on regular recruitment for the same posts.
  • Incomplete, incorrect or late online applications will be rejected and no correspondence will be entertained regarding such rejection.
  • The District Health Society/Collector, Bilaspur reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

KRCL Trainee Apprentices Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Passed 2021-2025)

  • Category I - Graduate Apprentices (Engineering): BE/BTech from AICTE-recognized university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category II - Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Diploma from recognized board/university in Civil/ Electrical (or sub-streams)/ Electronics (or sub-streams)/ Mechanical (or sub-streams).
  • Category III - Graduate Apprentices (General Stream): BA/BSc/BCom/BBA/BMS/BJMC/BBS from UGC-recognized university.

  1. Merit List: Aggregate percentage of all semesters/years (no rounding, no weightage per semester).
  2. Tie-Breaker: Older age, then earlier matriculation exam pass date.
  3. Shortlisting: 3 times the vacancies called for first round of Document Verification (DV); more if needed.
  4. Final medical fitness by KRCL.

No written exam or interview. Candidature cancelled if discrepancies found.

  • No lodging/boarding provided; candidates arrange own.

  1. Register on NATS portal and get approved NATS ID.
  2. Visit KRCL website: https://konkanrailway.com.
  3. Go to Quick Links → Graduate Apprentice/Technician Apprentice.
  4. Read notification and fill online application form (keep email/mobile active).

  7. Submit and print confirmation (no hard copy to send).
  8. Shortlisted candidates appear for DV with originals and photocopies.

Important Notes:

  • Apply for correct slot based on qualification; wrong slot leads to rejection.
  • No TA/DA for DV.
  • Keep Aadhaar-linked bank account and PAN for stipend.

  • Engagement is subject to medical fitness as prescribed by IRCTC.

  • This engagement is purely contractual and does not confer any right for regular/permanent employment in IRCTC.

  • Those working in Government/PSUs may apply through proper channel or submit NOC at the time of interview or proper relieving letter in case of selection.
  • IRCTC reserves the right to cancel/amend the advertisement and/or selection process at any time without prior notice.
  • The number of vacancies (including Reserve Panel) may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement at the time of engagement.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil eligibility criteria; furnishing false/incorrect information or suppression of material facts will lead to termination of candidature/services.
  • Selected candidates must furnish a security deposit of Rs. 25,000/- in the form of Demand Draft payable to IRCTC Ltd., Mumbai.

  • Knowledge of computer (MS Office) and report preparation, and ability to solve problems and make rational decisions, are desirable.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the prescribed application form attached with the notification, ensuring all fields are complete and accurate.
  • Report at the chosen walk-in venue on the specified date and time with:
    • Duly filled and signed application form.
    • Original certificates and one set of attested copies of educational qualification, experience, date of birth and category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PwBD) as applicable.

  • Submit the application form and documents at the venue for verification before the interview.

  • Stage 2 - Document Verification: A category-wise list will be drawn of the candidates who qualify the written test.   • Stage 3 - Group Discussion/Interview: The candidates, who clear the Document Verification round, shall only be eligible for the Group Discussion/Interview. Candidates need to secure minimum 40% marks for General/EWS and 35% marks for SC/ST/PwBD/OBC to qualify

Important Dates
