Last Date for Forwarding by Ports 30 March 2026

Selection Process

  • The selection is by merit for which overall grading in the ACRs/APARs should not be below "Very Good".
  • The selection is by merit for which the bench mark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports will not be below "very good".

General Information / Instructions

  • The post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (Pre-revised Rs.43200-66000) will fall vacant w.e.f. 13.02.2026, which is required to be filled by absorption through composite method from Officers of Major Port Authorities, fulfilling the eligibility criteria as per the RRs as indicated in the Annexure – I. attached herewith.
  • As directed by the Ministry vide letter dated 19.11.2019, the incumbent will be initially appointed to the HOD post in the scale of pay of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (pre-revised Rs.43200-66000) and after completion of three years' regular service in the post, he/she will be elevated to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000 (Revised) (pre-revised Rs.51300-73000) subject to fulfilling the relevant conditions as per the Ministry's guidelines vide letter No. A-12023/15/2018-PE-I dated 19.11.2019.
  • It may be noted that any changes as directed by the Ministry from time to time, will be made applicable.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019, in case of receipt of advance copy of application in respect of any applicant by the Port, candidature of the candidate will not be considered by the Ministry if his/her application is not received through proper channel by the Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications, i.e. on or before 30.03.2026. Further, the Ministry vide letter dated 20.09.2022 has issued the advisory in continuation to its earlier guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities wherein it is inter-alia stated that, "In this connection, it is to clarified that certain documents viz.
  • obtaining vigilance clearance, APARs of the candidate may take some time due to administrative formalities. In such scenario, the ports need to forward the application of the officer with the approval of the competent authority (i.e through proper channel) to the port which has issued advertisement before due date of submission of application.
  • Such applications through proper channel (even through without APARs, Vigilance, etc.) will be taken into consideration by the Ministry for appointment to HOD level posts.
  • However, for consideration of candidature of the candidate by the Selection Committee, the Ports are required to forward the remaining documents without necessary delay.
  • At various instances, the Ports forward the applications of the candidates in the last hours.
  • Thus, it becomes impossible for the applications to reach the Port that issued advertisement before due date of submission. In such cases, the ports are required to forward his/her application (through proper channel i.e. forwarding of the Port alongwith printout of OAP application) via email so that the candidature of the candidate could be considered for the post. Subsequently, the complete application of the candidate alongwith other documents may be forwarded by the Port by registered Post to the Port that issued advertisement".
  • The crucial date of eligibility criteria will be the last date of closing of application i.e. 14.03.2026, in terms of Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways circular No. I-26/25/2013-PE-I dated 26.09.2019. If any major or minor penalty has been imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to such penalty along with necessary documents may be sent by the forwarding authority along with the application.
  • Vigilance report is to be furnished in the format prescribed, vide Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterway's letter No.A-12023/2/2021-PE-1 dated 20.1.2021, copy of which is attached as Annexure-III.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official, who withdraws his/her candidature for the post after his/her selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years. Incomplete applications or applications not made following the stated procedure or received after due date will not be considered.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing Officers of all the Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions, for the post of Secretary in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 as per Annexure-I. The application may be submitted through "Online Application Portal" (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways website https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 13.02.2026 to 14.03.2026. No application other than OAP shall be accepted.
  • The candidate will have to submit the printout of application form already uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding. The administrative Ports are required to forward the applications of the candidates alongwith the following documents on or before 30.03.2026 superscribing "Application for the post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority".
  • (i) Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each of the pages.
  • (ii) A statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs/APARs and grading duly signed by the Dy. Chairperson/Chairperson as per the Ministry's letter dated 01.02.2007. If ACR/APAR for a particular year during the last 5 years period is pending/not available, "No Report Certificate" may be furnished alongwith ACRs/APARs of the preceding years.
  • (iii) Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
  • (iv) No objection certificate from the respective Port.
  • (v) Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II).
  • (vi) An undertaking of the applicant to the effect that candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected by Services Selection Committee.
  • (vii) Vigilance and Administrative clearance of the concerned Port, as per enclosed proforma (Annexure-III)
  • (viii) The veracity of the professional certificates and caste certificate provided in terms of letter no.A-12022/10/2005-PE-I dated 27.8.2010 by the applicant may be ensured and certified.
  • (ix) Two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope.

    • One Tier (Technical) – Post Codes 07/26, 08/26, 09/26, 10/26, 11/26, 13/26, 14/26, 16/26, 18/26, 19/26, 20/26: One Tier exam (I-T-T) of 2 hours duration. Total 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks. Section-A: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Test of Hindi Language & Comprehension, Test of English Language & Comprehension (20 marks each; 100 questions: 100 marks). Section-B: Objective type MCQs on the subject concerned as per the qualification prescribed for the post (100 questions: 100 marks). Mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable only in domain subject specific Section-B, not in Section-A. Combined marks of both sections reckoned for final merit list.
    • Two Tier (General) – Post Code 12/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-G). Tier-I (2 hours): 200 MCQ questions of 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks) + Part-II Descriptive (75 marks) = Grand Total 275. Part-II: Essay in English (50 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (25 marks). Selection based on cumulative marks obtained in Part-I & Part-II of Tier-II.
    • Two Tier (Technical-2) – Post Codes 01/26, 02/26, 03/26, 04/26, 05/26, 06/26, 15/26: Two-tier exam (II-T-T2). Tier-I (2 hours): Section-A (100 questions: 100 marks, general) + Section-B (100 questions: 100 marks, subject-related) = 200 marks (qualifying in nature). Tier-II (3 hours, one session): Part-I MCQ (200 questions: 200 marks, subject-related) + Part-II Descriptive (50 marks) = Grand Total 250. Part-II: Essay in English (30 marks) + Letter writing/Expansion of ideas in English (20 marks). In Tier-II, mandatory minimum qualifying marks applicable in domain subject specific Part-I; combined marks of both parts reckoned for final merit list.

  • Candidates must go through the instructions carefully while filling up the online application form for the post concerned.
  • Candidates must submit their application through Online Mode only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode i.e. by post / by hand / by mail etc. will not be accepted.
  • Pay the application fee of ₹100/- through SBI e-Pay only. No other mode of payment shall be accepted.
  • Before submission of the online application, candidates must check and ensure that they have filled correct details. Once the online application form is submitted, no request for change/correction/modification (including change of category) shall be entertained.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application much before the closing date and not to wait till the last date.
  • If an applicant submits multiple registrations and appears in the examination more than once, his/her candidature will be cancelled and he/she will be debarred from the examinations of the Board.
  • Candidates are advised to upload a recent and clear colour photograph. The background should be plain white or off-white, with full face, front view, eyes open.
  • Candidates must fill their correct and active e-mail addresses and mobile numbers in the online application form.
  • After successful submission, candidates should take a printout of the online application form for their own records.

  • Applications submitted without the prescribed fee/mode (unless remission of fee is claimed) shall be summarily rejected
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection
  • Important: No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS candidates and they are required to pay the full prescribed fee

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 20/02/2026
Start Date of Online Application 20/02/2026
Last Date of Online Application 12/03/2026 (till 18:00 hours)
Written Examination Date 19th July, 2026
Written Exam Timing - Paper-I 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon
Written Exam Timing - Paper-II 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
e-Admit Card Download Date Last working day of preceding week of examination date
Physical Standards Tests / Physical Efficiency Tests After declaration of Written Exam result
Interview / Personality Test After PST/PET (for qualified candidates)
Medical Standards Tests After Interview / Personality Test

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Written Examination (19th July, 2026)
    • Paper-I: General Ability and Intelligence - 250 Marks
      • Duration: 2 hours (10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon)
      • Type: Objective (Multiple Choice) Type questions
      • Medium: English as well as Hindi
      • Subjects: General Mental Ability (logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude, numerical ability, data interpretation), General Science, Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Polity & Economy, History of India, Indian & World Geography
      • There will be penalty (Negative Marking) for wrong answers: One third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
    • Paper-II: General Studies, Essay and Comprehension - 200 Marks
      • Duration: 3 hours (2:00 PM to 5:00 PM)
      • Type: Conventional (Descriptive) Type
      • Part-A: Essay questions (80 Marks) - to be answered in long narrative form either in Hindi or English. Topics: modern Indian history especially freedom struggle, geography, polity and economy, security and human rights issues, analytical ability
      • Part-B: Comprehension, précis writing, other communications/language skills (120 Marks) - to be attempted in English only. Topics: Comprehension passages, précis writing, developing counter arguments, simple grammar and other language testing aspects
      • Candidates must write answers only in the medium allowed. No credit for answers written in other medium
    • There will be minimum qualifying marks separately in each Paper as may be fixed by the Commission
    • Paper-I will be evaluated first and Paper-II will be evaluated only for those who obtain minimum qualifying marks in Paper-I
  • Stage 2: Physical Standards Tests (PST) / Physical Efficiency Tests (PET)
    • Conducted for candidates qualified in Written Examination
    • Physical Standards Requirements:
      • Men: Height 165 cm, Chest 81 cm (unexpanded) with 5 cm minimum expansion, Weight 50 kg
      • Women: Height 157 cm, Weight 46 kg
      • Height and chest measurement will be measured correct to one decimal in centimeter
      • Weight should be as per height and age as per prescribed chart
    • Physical Efficiency Tests:
      • Men: 100 Meter Race in 16 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 3 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.5 Meters (3 Chances), Shot Put (7.26 Kg) 4.5 Meters (3 Chances)
      • Women: 100 Meter Race in 18 Seconds, 800 Meter Race in 4 Min 45 Sec, Long Jump 3.0 Meters (3 Chances)
    • Female candidates must submit self-declaration about pregnancy status before PST/PET
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Stage 3: Interview / Personality Test
    • Only for candidates qualified in PST/PET
    • Marks: 150 Marks
    • Conducted by Union Public Service Commission
    • Candidates declared unqualified in PET will not be called for Interview
    • NCC 'B' or 'C' Certificate holders will be given consideration at Interview stage
  • Stage 4: Medical Standards Tests (MST)
    • Conducted only for candidates who appeared in Interview/Personality Test
    • Detailed Medical Standards prescribed for Eye Sight, Ear, Nose, Neck, Teeth, General Health, etc.
    • Eye Sight: Better eye 6/6 or 6/9 (corrected), Worse eye 6/12 or 6/9 (corrected), Near Vision N6/N9 (corrected), Colour Perception CP-III by ISIHARA plates
    • LASIK surgery correction permitted subject to prescribed criteria
    • Candidates declared 'UNFIT' can appear before Review Medical Board preferably next day of DME
    • Appeals against MST results must be made within 24 hours after declaration of DME results
    • Conducted under supervision of Nodal Authority appointed by Ministry of Home Affairs
  • Final Selection/Merit:
    • Merit list drawn on basis of marks obtained in Written Examination and Interview/Personality Test
    • Any candidate found not satisfying prescribed Medical Standards after MST will not be appointed
    • Tie Breaking Principle: (i) Higher marks in written total, (ii) Higher marks in Paper-I, (iii) Senior in age, (iv) At Commission's discretion

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only using the Commission's website: https://upsconline.nic.in
  • No other mode is allowed for submission of application
  • Application Process has Four Modules:
    • Module 1: Account Creation - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 2: Universal Registration (URN) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams). URN generated is unique and remains constant for all UPSC exams
    • Module 3: Common Application Form (CAF) - Can be filled anytime (common for all exams)
    • Module 4: Examination Specific Module - Can be filled only during notification period (includes fees, centres, force preferences, etc.)
  • Documents Required:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (scanned in .jpg format, 20 KB to 200 KB)
    • Signature (scanned - sign three times one below other on plain white paper using black ink, .jpg format, 20 KB to 100 KB)
    • Live photograph (to be captured while filling CAF)
    • One Photo ID Card details (Aadhaar/Voter/PAN/Passport/Driving License/Any other Government Photo ID)
    • Date of Birth certificate (Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate)

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

About Agnipath Scheme

The Agnipath Scheme is a visionary and transformative initiative by the Government of India to strengthen the Armed Forces through recruitment of young talent. The scheme provides an opportunity for Indian youth to serve the nation for a defined period, gain professional experience, develop leadership qualities, and acquire valuable skills. Agniveers (personnel recruited under this scheme) will undergo comprehensive training and skill development during their service period. Upon completion of 4 years of service, outstanding performers may be eligible for permanent enrollment in the regular cadre based on merit and organizational requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

Age Limit

  • Date of Birth Range: Candidates born between 02 July 2005 and 02 January 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply
  • Age at Time of Enrollment: If selected through all stages, the upper age limit at the time of actual enrollment should not exceed 21 years
  • Age Calculation: Age will be calculated as on the date of registration

Marital Status (Very Important)

  • Must be Unmarried: Only unmarried male candidates are eligible for recruitment as Agniveervayu Non-Combatant
  • Marriage Undertaking: Selected candidates must sign a voluntary undertaking that they will NOT marry during the 4-year engagement period
  • Breach of Undertaking: Any Agniveervayu Non-Combatant who marries during the engagement period will be immediately discharged from service without any benefits
  • Regular Cadre Eligibility: Only unmarried Agniveervayu Non-Combatant will be considered for selection in regular cadre as Non-Combatant(E) after 4 years

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum Qualification: Passed Matriculation (10th Standard) or equivalent examination
  • Recognized Board: Must be from education boards recognized by Central, State, or Union Territory as on the date of registration
  • Proof Required: Original matriculation certificate or mark sheet mandatory

Nationality & Residency

  • Must be an Indian citizen
  • Must be a permanent resident of India

Physical & Medical Standards

Physical Requirements

Parameter Requirement
Minimum Height 152 cm (centimeters)
Chest Expansion Minimum 5 cm
Weight Proportionate to height and age

Medical Standards

Vision Standards

  • Refractive Error: Not exceeding ± 3.5 D (diopters) including astigmatism
  • Visual Acuity: 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye
  • Color Vision: CP-III standard
  • Note: Corneal surgery (PRK/LASIK) is NOT acceptable

Hearing Standards

  • Candidate must have normal hearing capability
  • Able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters with each ear separately

Dental Standards

  • Healthy gums and good set of teeth
  • Minimum 14 dental points required
  • Dental implants and implant-supported prosthesis will NOT be awarded any points
  • Candidates wearing fixed or removable orthodontic appliances will be declared UNFIT

General Health Standards

  • Must be fit for the Indian Air Force according to all medical standards
  • Normal body anatomy without loss of any appendages
  • Free from any active or latent, acute or chronic medical or surgical disability
  • No communicable diseases, infections, or skin ailments
  • Physically and mentally FIT to perform duty in any climate, terrain, and region worldwide

General Disqualifications

Narcotic Drugs & Substance Abuse (ZERO TOLERANCE)

  • Consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) banned under NDPS Act 1985 is a rejection criterion
  • Agniveers found in possession, storing, distributing, or consuming such drugs after enrollment shall be liable for disciplinary action including dismissal
  • IAF follows ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY to alcoholism and substance abuse

Body Tattoos

  • Permanent body tattoos are generally NOT permitted
  • Exceptions: Tattoos only on inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist), back of hand, and tribal tattoos as per custom may be considered
  • Final decision on acceptability rests with the Selection Centre
  • Candidates with tattoos must submit two photographs (close-up and distant view) with details during selection test

Gender-Related Disqualifications

  • Candidates found to have predominant characteristics of opposite gender will be rejected as UNFIT
  • Any candidate having undergone gender reassignment surgery will be declared UNFIT

Selection Process

  1. Offline Application: Submit application through official portal https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
  2. Initial Screening: Applications will be reviewed for eligibility criteria compliance
  3. Phase I - Written Test: Common entrance examination for basic knowledge
  4. Phase II - Physical Fitness Test (PFT): 1.6 km run, push-ups, sit-ups, and other physical tests
  5. Phase III - Medical Examination: Complete medical examination as per IAF medical standards
  6. Phase IV - Medical Review Board: Final medical fitness decision
  7. Documentation & Verification: Document verification and background check
  8. Final Merit List: Selection based on overall performance and merit

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official IAF Agnipath portal: https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
  2. Navigate to "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" section
  3. Click on "Application Form" sub-tab
  4. Download blank application form and detailed instructions
  5. Read the Information Brochure thoroughly
  6. Fill the application form completely with accurate information
  7. Upload required documents as per instructions
  8. Submit the application Offline 
  9. Note the application reference number for future correspondence
  10. Keep checking the official website for updates regarding selection stages

Documents Required for Application

  • Photograph: Recent passport-size color photograph
  • Educational Certificate: Matriculation/10th pass certificate or equivalent
  • Date of Birth Proof: Birth certificate or school leaving certificate
  • Identification Proof: Aadhaar, Voter ID, or PAN card (any one)
  • Address Proof: Utility bills, rental agreement, or official document
  • Character Certificate: From school/college principal or local authorities
  • Medical Fitness Declaration: As per format provided
  • Caste/Category Certificate: If applicable (for SC/ST/OBC candidates)

Service Terms & Conditions

  • Contract Period: 4 years from date of enrollment
  • Employment Status: Contract-based, not permanent
  • Marital Status Condition: Must not marry during service period; discharge if marriage takes place
  • Training Phase: Comprehensive military training and skill development programs
  • Uniform & Discipline: Subject to military rules, regulations, and Standing Orders
  • Post-Service Options: Exceptional performers (approximately 25% annually) eligible for permanent enrollment as Non-Combatant(E) in regular cadre
  • Exit Benefits: Gratuity, terminal benefits, and other benefits as per government norms at the end of 4 years
  • Severance Pay: In case of medical discharge or other authorized reasons during service

Agniveer Benefits & Career Progression

During Service (4 Years)

  • Monthly stipend/salary as per government norms
  • Accommodation and meals provided
  • Medical and dental care (comprehensive)
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Professional training and skill development
  • Leadership and personality development programs
  • Uniform and necessary equipment
  • Leave benefits as per service rules

Post-Service Career

  • Permanent Cadre Option: Top 25% performers annually eligible for permanent selection as Non-Combatant(E) with service of 17 more years (total 21 years)
  • Civilian Skills: Training imparted during service makes Agniveers valuable in civilian job market
  • Preference in Government Jobs: Agniveers may get preference/weightage in some government sector recruitment
  • Entrepreneurship Support: Government schemes may support Agni veer entrepreneurs
  • Higher Education: Opportunity to pursue education in civilian field after service

Important Instructions & Cautions

  • Fair & Transparent Selection: Selection in IAF is strictly on MERIT and FAIR criteria. NO BRIBE or payments required at any stage
  • Beware of Fraud: Do NOT fall prey to unscrupulous agents claiming to be recruiting agents. All recruitment is through official channels only
  • Official Website Only: Use only official website https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/ for applications
  • No Backdoor Entry: No personal contacts, references, or influence will help in selection
  • Verify Information: Cross-verify all information from official notifications and brochure
  • Truthfulness: All information provided must be accurate; false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action

Eligibility Criteria for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

1. Educational Qualification

  • Performance Analyst (Physiotherapy): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Physiotherapy from any recognized University/Institution; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiotherapy.
  • Performance Analyst (Physiology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology / Biological Sciences; with specified equivalence for B.Sc. (CBZ) and Physiology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiology.
  • Performance Analyst (Anthropometry): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Anthropology or Human Biology; desirable 1 year experience in Anthropometry in sports science.
  • Performance Analyst (Psychology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology / Sports Psychology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Psychology.
  • Performance Analyst (Strength & Conditioning): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Strength and Conditioning / Sports and Exercise Science / Sports Science; OR Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Sports Coaching / Physical Education / Performance Coaching with specified Strength & Conditioning certifications (ACSM, NSCA-CSCS, ASCA, UKSCA, NCCA USCCA, NSNIS PG Diploma, NSDC Level 4/6/7, government-recognized gym/fitness certifications, EXOS with ACSM credits); desirable 1 year experience in Strength & Conditioning.
  • Performance Analyst (Nutrition): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Nutrition & Dietetics / Food Science & Nutrition / Sports Nutrition / Nutrition / Food & Nutrition / Food Nutrition & Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics / Home Science with specified Nutrition specializations; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Nutrition.
  • Performance Analyst (Biomechanics): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics & Kinesiology / Kinesiology (with Biomechanics) / Exercise & Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Human Movement Sciences / Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Biophysics / Physiotherapy (MPT Sports Biomechanics) with Biomechanics as major subject; with specified equivalent Bachelor’s degrees; desirable 1 year experience in Biomechanics.

Selection Process for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

The selection process will be based on a Computer-Based Test (CBT) with the following structure:

  • Mode: Computer-Based Test (CBT) in fully proctored environment with biometric authentication.
  • Duration: 2 hours.
  • Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

  • Section B (Discipline-specific): Applied Sports Science Knowledge – 40 marks.

  • Relaxations are provided to the candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC and for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) category. As per DOPT circular no. 36034/2/2013 dated April 08, 2013, in direct recruitment by way of All India Competitive Examination, the maximum relaxation of 5 years in upper age limit is allowed to Ex-servicemen for appointment in Group A (i.e., Officers cadre).
  • For candidates belonging to OBC category, certificate should specifically contain a clause that the candidate does not belong to creamy layer section and is excluded from the benefits of the reservation for other backward classes in civil posts and services under Government of India. OBC caste certificate containing the Non-Creamy layer clause should be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date for applying). Caste name mentioned in certificate should tally letter by letter with Central Government list/notification.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category but coming under creamy layer and/or if their caste does not find place in the Central List are not entitled to OBC reservation. They should indicate their category as General in the application form.
  • The selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India, depending on the requirement of the Bank. Therefore, only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • All the educational qualifications mentioned above should be from a University / Institution / Board recognized by Govt. of India / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. In case the date of passing is not properly mentioned in the mark- sheet or provisional certificate, proper document from Board / University indicating the date of declaration of results has to be submitted at the time of interview. In case the result of a particular examination is posted on the website of the University / Institute and web-based certificate is issued, then proper document / certificate in original issued and signed by the appropriate authority of the University / Institute indicating the date of passing that examination properly mentioned thereon will be reckoned for verification and further process
  • Only those who satisfy the required age and qualification criteria should apply. Applications that do not meet with the requirements will be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Interested candidates must fill in an Online Application Form. The application link will be live from January 26, 2026. Application in any other format will not be considered and will be rejected by the Bank, irrespective of fulfilling the eligibility criteria. Only Online Applications will be considered by the Bank. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Applicants are requested to ensure their eligibility before applying for any post. Fees once paid will not be refunded in case the applicant is not found to be eligible for the said post.
  • The date and timing of the Written test will be advised to the eligible candidates at a later date by notification on our website, personal email and/or SMS.
  • Depending upon the requirement and suitability of the candidates, the Bank reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the recruitment process including the number of vacancies, if need so arises, without any further notice and without assigning any reason therefor.
  • No correspondence will be entertained from any ineligible and non-selected candidate. In all matters regarding eligibility, the selection process, the stages at which the scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, documents to be produced for the selection process, assessment, prescribing minimum qualifying standards in the selection process, number of vacancies, communication of results, etc., the Bank’s decision shall be final and binding on the candidates and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • Selected candidates, who are already in service must produce a proper relieving letter / discharge certificate in original from their present employer at the time of joining, failing which they shall not be allowed to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates (Deputy Managers), at the time of joining the Bank, will have to execute a personal bond for ₹ 3 lakh to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 5 years from the date of joining the Bank.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim / dispute arising out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and courts / tribunals / forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any clause / dispute.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest that they should not furnish any particulars that are false, tampered with or fabricated and should not suppress any material information while submitting application. At the time of examination, interview or in a subsequent selection procedure, if a candidate is (or has been) found guilty of: (i) Using unfair means (ii) Impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person, OR (iii) Misbehaving in the examination/interview hall or disclosing, publishing, reproducing, transmitting, storing or facilitating transmission and storage of contents of the test(s) or any information therein in whole or part thereof in any form or by any means, verbal or written, electronically or mechanically for any purpose, OR (iv) Resorting to any irregular or improper means in connection with his/ her candidature, OR (v) Obtaining support for his/ her candidature by unfair means, OR (vi) Carrying mobile phones or similar electronic devices of communication in the examination/ interview hall. Such a candidate may, in addition to rendering himself/ herself liable to criminal prosecution, shall be liable; a) to be disqualified from the examination for which he/ she is a candidate: b) to be debarred either permanently or for a specified period from any examination conducted by the Bank. c) for termination of service, if he/ she has already joined the Bank.
  • CANDIDATES REPORTING LATE i.e., after the reporting time specified on the call letter for Examination will not be permitted to take the examination. The reporting time mentioned on the call letter is prior to the Start time of the test. Though the duration of the examination is 2 hours 30 minutes, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours including the time required for completion of various formalities such as verification and collection of various requisite documents, giving of instructions, etc.
  • In the examination hall as well as at the time of interview, the call letter along with original and a photocopy of the candidate’s currently valid photo identity (bearing exactly the same name as it appears on the call letter) such as PAN Card/ Passport/ Permanent Driving License/ Voter’s Card/ Bank Passbook with photograph/ Photo identity proof issued by a Gazetted Officer on official letterhead along with photograph / Photo identity proof issued by a People’s Representative on official letterhead along with photograph / valid recent Identity Card issued by a recognized College/ University/ Aadhar card/ E-Aadhar Card with a photograph/ Employee ID/ Bar Council Identity Card with photograph should be submitted to the invigilator for verification. The candidate’s identity will be verified with respect to his/her details on the call letter, in the Attendance List and requisite documents submitted. If identity of the candidate is in doubt the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the Examination.
  • Ration Card and Learner’s Driving License are not valid id proof.
  • Note: Candidates must produce in original the photo identity proof and submit photocopy of the photo identity proof along with Examination call letter as well as the Interview Call Letter while attending the examination/ interview respectively, without which they will not be allowed to take up the examination/ interview. Candidates must note that the name as appearing on the call letter (provided during the process of registration) should exactly match the name as appearing on the photo identity proof. Female candidates who have changed first/last/middle name post marriage must take special note of this. If there is any mismatch between the name indicated in the Call Letter and Photo Identity Proof the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the examination. In case of candidates who have changed their name, will be allowed only if they produce original Gazette notification / their original marriage certificate / affidavit in original.
  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to March 02, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

A total of 28 vacancies have been announced through the Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 for various Fixed Term Contract (FTC) and Executive positions.

Candidates who possess the required Bachelor’s Degree (10+2+3), MBA/MTM/Graduate Engineer, Full-Time Engineering Graduate, Company Secretary, B.Com, BCA/MCA, or other post-specific qualifications from AICTE/UGC-approved institutions are eligible to apply. For Other than Science Subjects:

  • Passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent Examination in any stream/subjects from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
  • Passed two years Vocational Course from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English in Vocational Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation if English is not a subject in Vocational Course).

Essential Requirements:

  • Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT as on date of registration shall only be considered.
  • Exact aggregate percentage of marks before decimal as written in the marks sheet shall only be considered (For example 49.99% should be taken as 49% and not to be rounded off to 50%).
  • Candidates eligible for Science Subjects examination are also eligible for Other than Science Subjects and would be given an option of appearing in both examinations in one sitting.

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹21,000/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹9,000/-)

  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- per month (In Hand: ₹25,550/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹10,950/-)

  • Seva Nidhi Package: Approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs after four years (₹5.02 lakh candidate contribution + ₹5.02 lakh Government contribution, excluding interest).
  • Insurance Cover: Non-contributory Life Insurance cover of ₹48 Lakhs for the duration of engagement period.

Selection Process

  • Phase-I - Online Test: Objective type test (bilingual - English & Hindi except English paper)
    • Science Subjects: 60 minutes - Physics, Mathematics and English as per 10+2 CBSE syllabus
    • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes - English and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA)
    • Both (Science & Other than Science): 85 minutes - Physics, Mathematics, English and RAGA
    • Marking Pattern: +1 mark for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -0.25 for wrong answer
  • Normalisation of Marks: Marks will be normalised to account for variation in difficulty levels across different sessions
  • Phase-II Testing at ASC: State-wise shortlisted candidates will be called for:
    • Document Verification
    • Physical Fitness Test (PFT-I & PFT-II)
    • Adaptability Test-I (Objective type written test)
    • Adaptability Test-II (As per policy in vogue)
  • Physical Fitness Test Details:
    • PFT-I: 1.6 Km run (Male: within 7 minutes, Female: within 8 minutes)
    • PFT-II for Male: 10 Push-ups (1 min), 10 Sit-ups (1 min), 20 Squats (1 min)
    • PFT-II for Female: 10 Sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 Squats (1 min)
  • Phase-III - Medical Examination: Conducted by Air Force Medical Team as per IAF medical standards including baseline investigations (Blood tests, Urine tests, X-Ray, ECG, USG for females, etc.)
  • Appeal Medical Board: Available for candidates declared medically unfit (Fee: ₹40/-)
  • Final Selection: Based on state-wise merit, medical fitness, availability of vacancies, and meeting all eligibility criteria

General Information/Instructions

  • Marital Status: Only unmarried candidates (male & female) are eligible. Candidates shall undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period. Marriage during service will result in discharge.
  • Pregnancy Policy: Female candidates shall undertake not to get pregnant during engagement period. Pregnancy will result in discharge and debar from Regular Cadre selection.
  • Medical Standards:
    • Height: Minimum 152 cms for male and female (relaxation for North East/hilly regions/Lakshadweep)
    • Weight: Proportionate to height and age
    • Chest: Male - minimum 77 cms with 5 cms expansion; Female - minimum 5 cms expansion
    • Vision: 6/12 each eye correctable to 6/6, Colour Vision: CP-II
    • Hearing: Normal - able to hear forced whisper from 6 meters
    • Dental: Minimum 14 dental points with healthy gums
    • No history of LASIK/PRK surgery
  • Body Tattoo: Permanent body tattoos not permitted except on inner forearms, back of hand/palm, and tribal tattoos as per custom. Offensive tattoos prohibited.
  • NDPS Policy: Zero tolerance to consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances. Consumption is a reject criterion.
  • Domicile Categories: Permanent Domicile, COAFP-I (Children of Serving Air Force Personnel), COAFP-II (Children of Retired/Discharged/Deceased Air Force Personnel)
  • Engagement Period: Four years under Air Force Act 1950
  • Regular Cadre Opportunity: Up to 25% of each batch may be enrolled in regular cadre based on performance and organisational requirements
  • Leave Entitlement: 30 days annual leave per year plus sick leave as per medical advice
  • Medical & CSD Facilities: Available at Service Hospitals during engagement period
  • No ESM Status: Agniveervayu will not be eligible for Ex-Servicemen status after completion of four years
  • NDA/AFCAT Attempts: Permitted to appear (maximum three attempts) during engagement period subject to conditions
  • Identification Requirements: AADHAAR Card mandatory (exemption for J&K, Ladakh, Assam, Meghalaya candidates)

  • No TA/DA: No travel allowance or daily allowance admissible for any stage of selection
  • Mobile Phones Prohibited: Mobile phones/smart watches/electronic devices prohibited in testing areas. Possession will result in permanent debarment.
  • Malpractices: Candidates found indulging in malpractices/unfair means shall be debarred permanently
  • Disclaimer: IAF reserves the right to cancel entire selection process at any stage without assigning any reasons

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression

  • Pen will be provided during exam

Important Warnings:

  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

  • General Awareness: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer

  • Maximum Marks: 300 (3 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: 1 mark per wrong answer
  • Topics: Concerned subject as per post code applied

  1. Higher marks in concerned subject/trade papers
  2. Lesser negative marks in concerned subject/trade
  3. Lesser negative marks in all evaluated papers
  4. Older candidate (Date of Birth)
  5. Earlier acquisition of Essential Degree
  6. Alphabetical order of first names

SPMCIL Young Professional Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Essential)

  • 1st class Full Time B.E./B.Tech from a recognized University/Institute in:
    • Computer Science Engineering
    • Information Technology
    • Electronics & Communication Engineering
    with minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.

Professional Certification (Essential)

Candidates must possess at least ONE of the following certifications:

  • CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)
  • CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CompTIA CySA+ (CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst)
  • GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials Certification)
  • OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

Experience (Essential)

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant cyber security experience in reputed companies/organizations.

Preference

  • Candidates with specialization in Cyber Security at Post Graduate level (M.Tech / MBA) will be given preference.
  • Multiple certifications from the above list will be considered an added advantage.

SPMCIL Young Professional Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 35 years as on 07-02-2026.
  • Candidates born on or after 07-02-1991 are eligible.
  • Age relaxation applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories.

SPMCIL Young Professional Salary & Benefits

Monthly Remuneration Rs. 50,000/- (all inclusive)
Annual Increment 8% annual increase in remuneration
Leave Entitlement 1 day paid leave for every 20 days of work
Mediclaim Reimbursement Up to Rs. 2,00,000/- premium reimbursement for group mediclaim policy (self, spouse, dependent children) for engagement exceeding 6 months
TA/DA for Official Duty As per E-1 level officer standards for out-station deputation (no TA/DA for joining/completion)
Other Benefits No DA, accommodation, telephone, conveyance, transport, personal staff, or other medical reimbursement.

Service Conditions

  • Leave can be availed only after it becomes due and with approval of the controlling officer.
  • No TA/DA for joining or completion of assignment; admissible only for official duty tours.
  • Mediclaim premium reimbursement up to Rs. 2 lakh for self, spouse and dependent children for engagements longer than 6 months.
  • No other allowances or benefits apart from what is mentioned in the notification.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

A. Security Architecture and Design

  • Develop and maintain robust cyber security architecture aligned with NIST, ISO 27001 and other industry best practices.
  • Design and implement secure solutions for network segmentation, threat detection and incident response across IT and OT environments.
  • Collaborate with IT and OT teams to integrate cyber security controls into existing and upcoming systems.
  • Stay updated on emerging threats, vulnerabilities and technologies and recommend necessary infrastructure enhancements.

B. Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of IT and OT systems and networks.
  • Develop and monitor remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for timely patching and system updates.

C. Threat Detection and Incident Response

  • Implement and continuously monitor security tools (IDS/IPS, SIEM) to detect anomalies and potential threats.
  • Lead cyber security incident response activities ensuring prompt containment, mitigation and post-incident analysis.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and conduct forensic investigations when required.

D. Risk Management and Compliance

  • Perform cyber risk assessments to identify threats and evaluate operational impact.
  • Ensure adherence to national/international standards, guidelines and data protection laws including CERT-In guidelines.
  • Develop, update and enforce cyber security policies, procedures and standards.
  • Lead internal audits and report findings to senior management.

E. Awareness and Training

  • Design and deliver cyber security awareness programs for staff, contractors and third-party vendors.
  • Create security campaigns and materials to promote a security-aware culture across the organization.

F. Collaboration and Reporting

  • Coordinate with IT, OT and functional departments to ensure a secure operational environment.
  • Prepare and present risk posture reports, threat intelligence and mitigation strategies to senior management.

Required Skill Set

  • Strong knowledge of cyber security concepts, principles and frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Endpoint Protection Platforms
    • SIEM tools (e.g. Forti SIEM, Splunk)
    • Vulnerability scanners (e.g. Nessus, Qualys)
    • Incident response and digital forensics tools
  • Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical and incident handling capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey complex technical details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of IT and OT environment security.
  • Understanding of CERT-In guidelines and national cyber security frameworks.

Important General Conditions

  • Engagement is purely on fixed-term contract (temporary basis) and does not confer any right to permanent employment.
  • Appointment is on full-time basis; candidates are not permitted to take up any other assignment during the contract period.
  • SPMCIL reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of tenure will not give any claim for future regular appointment in SPMCIL.
  • Tenure is 3 years, extendable based on performance or liable to be terminated earlier.
  • If engagement falls during election period, it will be regulated as per Election Commission of India guidelines.

SPMCIL Young Professional Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of applications for eligibility based on educational qualification, experience and professional certifications.
  • Merit-based shortlisting as per qualification and experience profile.
  • Screening process may consist of written test followed by interview or only interview as decided by the Management.
  • Document verification of all original certificates at the time of screening/interview.
  • Final selection based on interview performance and overall suitability for the role.

How to Apply for SPMCIL Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Application Mode: Online only through SPMCIL website.

Application Period: 07-02-2026 (10:00 AM) to 06-03-2026 (5:00 PM)

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.spmcil.com.
  2. Click on the “Career” link available on the home page.
  3. Click on the “ONLINE APPLICATION” button for Young Professional – Cyber Security Expert.
  4. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully.
  5. Upload all required documents (educational certificates, experience certificates, professional certifications, photograph, signature, etc.).
  6. Submit the application form and wait for server confirmation (do not press back or refresh after submission).
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

Offline/any other mode of application will not be accepted. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for updates on screening, interview schedule and selection list.

Documents Required

  • B.E./B.Tech degree certificate and all semester mark sheets.
  • Proof of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (conversion to percentage if only CGPA/grades are awarded).
  • Professional certification(s) – CEH/CCSP/CISSP/CompTIA CySA+/GSEC/OSCP/CISM (scanned copies).

  • Updated detailed resume/CV highlighting cyber security expertise and achievements.
  • 10th/12th certificate as proof of date of birth.
