  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) or PwBD certificate, if applicable, in prescribed format.
  • Disability certificate issued by competent medical board (for PwBD).
  • Recent passport-size photographs as per specifications in notification.

Notification PDF

The official notification for CONCOR Recruitment 2026 for Finance & Accounts posts has been released by Container Corporation of India Limited. Candidates can download the official notification PDF to get complete details about the recruitment, including vacancy details, eligibility criteria, application procedure, and important dates.

? Download Official Notification PDF

Vacancy Details

Container Corporation of India (CONCOR) is recruiting for 5 posts in the Finance & Accounts department on an immediate absorption basis. This is a special recruitment drive for experienced professionals already working in Government/PSU/State Government organizations. All posts are on a permanent/regular basis.

Post Name Grade No. of Vacancies Pay Scale (IDA)
Senior Manager (Finance & Accounts) E-4 1 ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000
Manager (Finance & Accounts) E-3 2 ₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000
Manager (Finance & Accounts/Compliance) E-3 1 ₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000
Junior Officer (Finance & Accounts) S-2 1 ₹44,000 - ₹1,53,000
Total 5 -

Eligibility Criteria

Immediate Absorption Basis: This recruitment is only for candidates currently working in Central Government / State Government / PSU / Other Government organizations on regular basis.

1. Senior Manager (Finance & Accounts) - E-4 Grade

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA (Chartered Accountant) from ICAI or CMA (Cost Management Accountant) from ICMAI with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹70,000-2,00,000 / Pay Matrix Level 11 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 40 years as on 12-03-2026

2. Manager (Finance & Accounts) - E-3 Grade (2 Posts)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA (Chartered Accountant) from ICAI or CMA (Cost Management Accountant) from ICMAI with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 / Pay Matrix Level 9 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

3. Manager (Finance & Accounts/Compliance) - E-3 Grade (1 Post)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CS (Company Secretary) from ICSI (Institute of Company Secretaries of India) with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 / Pay Matrix Level 9 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

4. Junior Officer (Finance & Accounts) - S-2 Grade (1 Post)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA Intermediate from ICAI or CMA Intermediate from ICMAI.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹44,000-1,53,000 / Pay Matrix Level 7 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹40,000-1,36,000 / Pay Matrix Level 6 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

Important Notes:

  • Post/pay-scale held on temporary, contract, adhoc, deputation, non-functional upgradation, or MACP financial upgradation basis shall not be considered for eligibility.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by Government of India.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognized by AICTE/UGC/appropriate statutory authority of Government of India.
  • Candidates on deputation to other organizations must satisfy eligibility conditions based on parent organization.
  • The cutoff date for age, experience, and qualification is 12-03-2026.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 10-02-2026
Application Process Opens 10-02-2026
Last Date for Submission 12-03-2026
Expected Interview/PPT To be announced later

Selection Process

The selection process for CONCOR Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following:

  1. Shortlisting: Only candidates fulfilling all eligibility criteria will be shortlisted. In case of large number of eligible applicants, CONCOR reserves the right to shortlist limited candidates based on relevant qualifications, additional professional qualifications, experience, and achievements.
  2. Interview/Power Point Presentation (PPT): Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and/or power point presentation.
  3. Performance Assessment: Assessment based on APARs (Annual Performance Appraisal Reports) for the preceding three years.
  4. Weightage Criteria: Weightage will be given to APAR ratings, experience profile, additional professional qualifications, and personality traits as per extant policy.
  5. Reservation: Reservation rules are NOT applicable for immediate absorption recruitment.
  6. Communication: Names of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on www.concorindia.co.in. Email notifications will be sent to shortlisted candidates.

Important: CONCOR reserves the right to modify or amend any part of the selection process at any stage before the interview.

Salary/Stipend

The selected candidates will be offered competitive compensation packages as per the following pay scales:

Post Grade Pay Scale (IDA) Basic + DA
Senior Manager (Finance & Accounts) E-4 ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000 As per IDA pay pattern
Manager (Finance & Accounts) E-3 ₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000 As per IDA pay pattern
Manager (Finance & Accounts/Compliance) E-3 ₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000 As per IDA pay pattern
Junior Officer (Finance & Accounts) S-2 ₹44,000 - ₹1,53,000 As per IDA pay pattern

Additional Benefits: The company offers an attractive compensation package including:

  • Leased accommodation or HRA
  • Perks & Allowances under cafeteria approach
  • Performance-related pay
  • Medical facilities and group insurance
  • Pension and CPF benefits
  • Post-retirement medical benefits
  • Gratuity as per extant policies

How to Apply

Application Process: This is an offline recruitment on immediate absorption basis. Applications must be submitted through the proper channel of the candidate's parent organization.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

  1. Visit CONCOR website: www.concorindia.co.in
  2. Go to HR & Career → Recruitment Notices & Results section
  3. Download the application form (Vacancy Notice No. 01/2026)
  4. Read the detailed vacancy advertisement carefully
  5. Fill the application form in English language in block letters
  6. Ensure the application is properly signed
  7. Prepare required documents and certificates (as mentioned below)
  8. Submit through Proper Channel: Submit the completed application to your parent organization's HR department requesting them to forward the application along with:
    • No Objection Certificate (NOC)
    • Department & Action Record (D&AR)
    • Vigilance Clearance
    • APARs for preceding 3 years
    • Guidelines on APAR rating criteria (if different from APARs)
  9. Mailing Address: The parent organization should forward the complete application to:
    Sr. General Manager (Human Resources)
    Container Corporation of India Limited (CONCOR)
    3rd Floor, NSIC Business Park Building
    Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi - 110020
  10. The envelope should be superscribed: "Application for the post of _________________ under Sr. No. ______ on Immediate Absorption Basis"
  11. One envelope should contain only one application
  12. Candidates can apply for only ONE post (not multiple)
  13. Submit before 12-03-2026

Required Documents to Attach:

  • Latest self-attested passport size photograph
  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Professional qualification certificates (CA/CMA/CS)
  • Experience certificate from present/previous organizations clearly indicating grade, pay-scale, and field
  • Proof of age (birth certificate/school leaving certificate)
  • Proof of relevant experience in prescribed grade and pay scale
  • Pay scale structure document of the applicant's organization
  • Self-attested copies of all testimonials/documents
  • Original testimonials/documents (to be produced at interview)

Important Notes:

  • Unsigned applications will NOT be considered
  • Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected
  • Late submissions will be rejected
  • Candidates can apply for only ONE post (multiple applications will result in only the higher post application being retained)
  • Visit CONCOR website regularly for updates, notices, or corrigendum
  • In case of ambiguity, English version of the advertisement will prevail

  • Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) shall be applicable to the extent as communicated by the Indenting Department(s) in accordance with the extant rules/regulations.
  • The suitability/type of Disabilities/eligibility of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities for these posts under Horizontal Reservation shall be governed by the extant regulations.
  • Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen candidates is applicable as per extant rules, for the posts which carry Pay of and up to the Level-6E (35900-113500).
  • In terms of S.O. 361 of 2021 dated 20.10.2021, an Ex-Servicemen on joining any post after having availed Horizontal Reservation, cannot avail the benefit of Horizontal Reservation as Ex-Servicemen for any subsequent Employment. Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Associate Professor – Essential Qualifications:
    • A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines.

  • Assistant Professor – Essential Qualifications (Eligibility A or B):
    • Eligibility A: A Master's degree in English/Commerce/Computer Science/Mathematics with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited Foreign University. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016.

    • Desirable: Exposure to Online/Open Distance Education.

    • Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed.

Knowledge of data management tools and experience in handling student and course data is essential.   • Prior experience in two or more of: Density Functional Theory (DFT), Ab initio Molecular Dynamics, Classical Molecular Dynamics, Kinetic Monte Carlo.
  • Excellent programming skills (preferably Python, Fortran, or C++).
  • Analytical skills and knowledge of high-performance computing (HPC).
  • Added advantage: Expertise in high-throughput computing, machine learning methods, and optimization methods.

Experience Required: Prior relevant computational experience as listed above (post-Ph.D. research experience preferred but not explicitly mandated beyond skills).

Fellowship / Salary

Important Dates

  • Notification Release / Opening: Immediate / Recent (as of early 2026).
  • Application Start: Open now.
  • Application Last Date: February 6, 2026.
  • No other dates (exam, interview, etc.) specified—selection likely based on application review, possible interview.

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on CV, cover letter, research statement, recommendations, and qualifications.
  • Likely interview / discussion with the PI (Anirban Mondal).
  • Document verification (originals required upon selection).

How to Apply

Candidates must email their application as a single PDF file to [email protected].

Required Documents:

  1. Detailed CV (including academic records, fellowships, awards, publications, talks/posters, computational expertise).
  2. Cover letter explaining suitability for this position and project.
  3. Short research statement (maximum 1 page).
  4. Two letters of recommendation (sent directly by referees to [email protected]).
  5. Scanned copy of Ph.D. certificate (or formal confirmation/thesis submission proof).

Selected candidates must provide original degree certificates for verification—failure to do so cancels the offer.

Application Deadline: February 6, 2026.

Special Physical Standards

Candidates belonging to following regions will be given 4 cms height relaxation:

  • North East Region: Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya and Assam.
  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).
  • School Character Certificate.
  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.
  • NCC Certificate (if applicable).
  • Sports Certificate (if applicable).
  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Candidates must possess the following minimum educational qualification for the post of Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert (VC No. CP/07/26):

  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Technology in Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical / Railways / Mechatronics & Automobile or any of the above combinations in part or whole.

2. Minimum Post-Qualification Experience

Candidates should have the following minimum post-qualification experience (post degree) for CP/07/26:

  • Minimum 09 years’ experience in designing and optimizing bulk material handling systems.
  • Ability to develop process flow diagrams, capacity calculations, and optimization studies.
  • Experience and proficiency in material handling systems such as conveyors, stackers, reclaimers, ship loaders/unloaders, silos, wagon tipplers, and rapid loading systems.
  • Proven capability in project lifecycle management from feasibility to commissioning.
  • Experience in cost estimation, budgeting and lifecycle analysis of CAPEX and OPEX.

The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

Candidates must be eligible to work in India as per applicable laws and guidelines as implied in the notification.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

Candidates must possess eminent ability, integrity, standing, and experience in ANY ONE of the following areas:

  • (ii) Child Health, Care, Welfare or Child Development: Expertise in child health, childcare, welfare services, child development programs, or related areas in established institutions or organizations
  • (iii) Juvenile Justice or Care of Neglected, Marginalized, or Disabled Children: Professional experience in juvenile justice system, care of neglected children, marginalized children, children with disabilities, or children in distress
  • (iv) Elimination of Child Labour: Active involvement or expertise in programs, advocacy, or enforcement related to the elimination of child labour
  • (v) Child Psychology or Sociology: Specialized knowledge and experience in child psychology, developmental psychology, or sociology related to children and families
  • (vi) Laws Relating to Children: Legal expertise, judicial experience, or administrative background specifically related to laws, policies, and constitutional provisions affecting children

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: Below 60 years (age calculated as on the date of application submission)
  • No Lower Age Limit: Specified in the notification

Reservation

  • Women Reservation: 2 out of 6 posts are reserved exclusively for women candidates

Term of Office & Tenure

  • Tenure Duration: 3 years from the date of appointment
  • Early Removal: A member can be removed from office under Section 7(1) as per the relevant act
  • Re-nomination Eligibility: Members who have served as Members can be eligible for re-nomination as Chairperson or Member for two additional terms as per the rules
  • Chairperson Eligibility: A member who has already served as Chairperson can serve as a member again, or can be re-nominated as Chairperson for up to two terms

Particulars Details
Honorarium Rs. 2,000/- per meeting attended
Salary/Regular Pay None (Position is honorary in nature)
Additional Benefits Subject to Haryana Government rules and regulations issued from time to time
Frequency of Meetings As per commission schedule (typically monthly or as required)

Note: This is an honorary position. Members will be paid honorarium only for meetings attended, not a fixed monthly salary.

Duties & Responsibilities of Members

  • Child Rights Protection: Ensure protection and promotion of rights of all children in Haryana
  • Policy Advocacy: Advise government on policies and programs related to child welfare and protection
  • Investigation: Investigate cases of violation of child rights and initiate action
  • Public Awareness: Create awareness about child rights, child protection mechanisms, and welfare schemes
  • Interagency Coordination: Coordinate with government departments, NGOs, and other agencies for child protection
  • Monitoring: Monitor implementation of child protection laws, schemes, and programs
  • Complaint Redressal: Hear and address complaints related to child rights violations
  • Commission Meetings: Attend regular commission meetings and contribute to decision-making

How to Apply

Application Process

  • Application Format: Submit a detailed application with curriculum vitae (CV) highlighting qualifications, experience, and expertise
  • Application Method: Submit application through ANY ONE of the following modes:
  • • By Post to the Commission office address
  • • By Email to the Commission email address
  • Application Closing Date: 09-03-2026 (9 March 2026)
  • Late/Incomplete Applications: Will not be considered

Haryana State Commission for Protection of Child Rights
C-15, Adarsh Bhawan, Sector-6
Panchkula, Haryana

  • Full name and date of birth

  • Detailed CV highlighting:
  • • Educational qualifications with certificates
  • • Professional experience in relevant field(s)
  • • Expertise area as per eligibility criteria
  • • Achievements and contributions to child welfare
  • • Any publications, awards, or recognition
  • Declaration of age (must be below 60 years)
  • If applicable, statement indicating area of expertise (Education/Child Health/Juvenile Justice/Child Labour/Child Psychology/Child Laws)

Important Instructions & Terms

  • Closing Date: Applications must be received by 09-03-2026. Late applications will not be entertained
  • Completeness: Incomplete applications or those lacking required information will be rejected
  • Age Verification: Age must be verified as on the date of application. Candidates above 60 years are ineligible

  • No Conflict of Interest: Members must declare any potential conflicts of interest

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification: 10+2 Examination from a recognized Board of School Education/University.
  • OR Matriculation from recognized Board of School Education with one/two year Diploma/Certificate from an ITI in Information Technology (IT) & Information Technology Enabled Sectors (ITES) as notified by Directorate General of Employment & Training, Government of India, from time to time; OR three years Diploma in Computer Engineering/Computer Science/IT from a Polytechnic approved by AICTE.
  • Provided that the candidate must have passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any School/Institution situated within Himachal Pradesh; this condition shall not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Computer typing speed of 30 words per minute in English or 25 words per minute in Hindi is required.
  • Visually impaired persons selected/recruited under 1% quota are exempted from acquiring Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Application/IT and passing of typing test; they shall be imparted necessary basic and computer training by designated institutions and must qualify the training within the prescribed chances.
  • Differently abled persons otherwise qualified to hold clerical post, certified as being unable to type by the Medical Board, may be exempted from passing the typing test.
  • Desirable: Knowledge of customs, manners and dialects of Himachal Pradesh and suitability for appointment in the peculiar conditions prevailing in the Pradesh.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Junior Office Assistant (IT) (Job Trainee) carries a consolidated fixed amount of Rs. 12,500/- per month.
  • The recruitment and engagement as per this advertisement are governed by Department of Personnel guidelines referred to in the notification.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum age: 18 years.
  • Maximum age: 45 years.
  • The upper age limit for candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes, Persons with Disabilities categories who are domiciles of Himachal Pradesh, employees of Himachal Pradesh Government and Ex-servicemen of Himachal Pradesh is relaxable up to five (05) years as per Government of Himachal Pradesh orders.

Application Fee

  • Examination and other processing fees are prescribed category-wise in the notification under “EXAMINATION AND OTHER PROCESSING FEES”; fee is payable only through online payment (no other mode is acceptable).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded and will not be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.

Fee structure for an examination process.

  • Total Examination Fee: ₹800.00
  • Fee Breakdown: ₹100/- for examination fee and ₹700/- for processing fee.
  • Correction Fee: ₹100.00
  • Correction Window: Open for seven days, starting three working days after the closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORAS).

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Date 21-01-2026
Opening date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form 27-01-2026 (10:00 AM)
Closing date for submission of Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form 27-02-2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Date for determining eligibility (Essential Qualification/Experience) 27-02-2026 (till 11:59 PM)
Correction window for rectifying errors in ORA For 7 days, commencing after 3 working days from closing date of ORA (exact dates as per notification schedule)

Selection Process

  • Mode of Selection: Computer Based Test/Written screening test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration (or as decided by the Aayog) followed by a Typing Test, which shall be mandatory and qualifying in nature.
  • The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, each carrying 1 mark.
  • Scope of syllabus:
    – Subjects of 10+2 level prescribed as per essential qualification and as notified in the advertisement.
    – Syllabus relating to Computer Science/Computer Application/IT/ITES/Information Practices prescribed as essential qualification.
    – General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric standard.
  • Skill test on computer with minimum typing speed of 30 wpm in English or 25 wpm in Hindi for those who qualify screening test; skill test is of qualifying nature.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in written screening test/OMR/CBT: 45% for General category candidates and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/ Wards of Freedom Fighters; Aayog may relax qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% if required and record reasons in writing.
  • Where skill/physical test is essential, candidates will be shortlisted for such tests based on merit of MCQ/CBT as per ratios given (up to five times, specific caps for 30–40 and more than 40 posts).
  • In case of multiple-shift CBT examination, scores shall be normalized using Z-Score (Mean and Standard Deviation) method for merit preparation.
  • A category-wise waiting list/panel will be prepared, valid for one year from the date of sending recommendation by HPRCA to appointing authority; size of waiting panel depends on number of advertised posts as specified.

General Information/Instructions

  • Online Applications are invited through the official website of HPRCA (https://hprca.hp.gov.in); no offline application form will be accepted.
  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling the ORA and should carefully read instructions/terms and conditions before applying.
  • The downloaded copy of online application form along with necessary original certificates and self-attested photocopies must be brought at the time of document verification or whenever required by HPRCA.
  • Date for determining eligibility in respect of essential qualifications and experience shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of ORA.
  • Minimum and maximum age limits are reckoned as on 01.01.2026; category-wise relaxations apply only to domiciles of Himachal Pradesh as per rules.
  • Candidates must provide working mobile number and email ID in ORA and ensure their validity till completion of selection process; communication will be through SMS/e-mail and official website notices.
  • Number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease; posts of similar R&P Rules may be clubbed up to 31.05.2026 or till date of CBT/written test.
  • Benefit of reservation is admissible only to bonafide residents of Himachal Pradesh; reserved category candidates from other States will be treated as General (UR) and will not get reservation/fee concession.
  • The candidate shall be eligible for appointment if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh; this condition does not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Candidates of reserved categories of other States will be treated as General (UR) and the benefit of reservation and fee concession shall not be admissible.
  • Candidates will be admitted to selection process provisionally subject to verification of eligibility at document verification stage; furnishing incorrect information may lead to rejection.
  • Detailed instructions are given for validity and use of OBC, BPL, EWS and other certificates; candidates must possess valid certificates on the last date of ORA and at document verification.
  • PwBD candidates with functional limitations may avail scribe/reader and/or compensatory time as per detailed guidelines subject to prior authorization from HPRCA and necessary documentation.
  • Disqualifications include dismissal from previous service, conviction for offences involving moral turpitude, influence in selection process, prohibited marriages and being an un-discharged insolvent, as detailed in notification.
  • HPRCA reserves the right to change terms of advertisement, rectify errors, club posts, determine criteria where eligible candidates are fewer, and to implement clarifications/instructions from Government during recruitment process.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must first sign up on the HPRCA portal (https://hprca.hp.gov.in) to create a username and password.
  • After sign-up, candidates must complete One-Time Registration by providing personal information, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), uploading recent photograph, signature and relevant supporting documents.
  • Only users with a completed profile can apply for posts; profile can be updated for changes in qualifications or contact details.
  • Candidates can view available posts on HPRCA portal and click “Apply” for the desired post (Junior Office Assistant (IT) (Job Trainee), Post Code 26001).
  • Applicants must select preferred exam district(s) from the dropdown; HPRCA reserves the right to allot any district/centre due to constraints like availability of computer nodes.
  • The system auto-fills application details from profile; candidates must review and confirm application details.
  • Candidates must pay application fee through the prescribed online payment gateway; no other mode is accepted.
  • After successful payment, the application is considered complete; candidates should ensure no column is wrongly filled or left blank and that all required documents/certificates are uploaded.
  • The notification also provides a checklist and detailed steps for uploading Matric, qualification, experience, category and other certificates, which must be produced in original at documentation.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility

  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website

1. ERP Head (Supervisor/Consultant) – 1 Post

Essential Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.C.A

Essential Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in implementing, configuring and supporting ERP systems.

Desirable Skills:

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end processes, finance and statutory compliance.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Working experience in Agile Methodology.
  • Project experience in ERP development in Academic Institutions.
  • Technical skills: proficiency in database management (e.g., MS SQL), familiarity with integration tools and APIs.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Participate in scrum calls; supervise and coordinate daily activities of the ERP implementation team.
  • Convert business requirements to system requirements.
  • Draft user stories, epics, product backlog and documentation.
  • Handle and guide the implementation team.

Age Limit: 50 years (Age relaxation may be given to exceptional candidates).

V. Raman Avenue, Sadashivanagar, Bengaluru - 560080, India so as to reach the above-mentioned address by 28.02.2026.

Abbreviation used:

  • B/LV - Blindness/Low Vision
  • D - Deaf, HH - Hearing Impaired

  • ASD - Autism Spectrum Disorder, ID - Intellectual Disability, SLD - Specific Learning Disability, MI - Mental Illness

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

  • Company Secretary: Must have passed final examination of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and shall hold the Membership of the said Institute. Must have minimum of Five years' experience as Company Secretary in a Company having minimum paid capital of Rs 50 Crore or more.
  • Assistant Town Planner: Degree in Architecture (5 years full time course) with minimum 60% marks and Post Graduation in Town Planning from recognized University.
  • Programmer: B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in Information Technology/Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications or M.C.A. from a recognized University OR ME/M.Tech degree in Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications from a recognized University OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level/COPA/DPCS/Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Information Technology).
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Degree/Diploma/Certificate of CA/CMA from the institute of ICAI/ICMAI from a recognized university OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level or Higher/COPA/DPCS certificate/Diploma in Computer Science).
  • Junior Legal Officer: Law graduate (Professional Degree) from a recognized university with minimum 55% marks or LL.M. from a recognized university.
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC under control of the Department of Electronics, Government of India OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering from a polytechnic institution OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Diploma in Architecture from Polytechnic from recognized institute alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software OR Certificate course of Draughtsman (Civil) from National Council of Vocational Trade alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software.
  • Junior Assistant: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND "O" or Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.

Citizenship:

  • A citizen of India
  • A subject of Nepal
  • A subject of Bhutan
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January, 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka or East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India

Note: Candidates belonging to categories (b), (c), (d) and (e) above shall be a person in whose favour a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Home Department and Justice Department of Government of India.

Salary/Stipend

Appointment of selected candidates will be made for Probation Period for an initial period of two years. A fixed remuneration shall be payable to such candidates during the probation period:

  • Company Secretary: Level-16, Rs.4,7200/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Town Planner: Level-14, Rs.3,9300/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Programmer: Level-12, Rs.3,1100/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Level-11, Rs.2,6500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Legal Officer: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Level-8, Rs.1,8500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Assistant: Level-5, Rs.1,4600/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)

Note: On successful completion of Probation Period, the salary shall be payable in regular Pay-Matrix. The regular salary with other allowances shall be paid, as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: Less than 40 years

Age Relaxation:

  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Male Candidates of Rajasthan State: 5 years relaxation
  • General Category Women Candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Women Candidates of Rajasthan State: 10 years relaxation
  • Differently Abled Persons: Additional 5 years relaxation beyond the above-mentioned relaxations
  • Widow and Divorcee: No upper age limit, but at the time of appointment, their age should be less than the age of superannuation fixed by RIICO

Note: The provisions for relaxation in upper age limit are non-cumulative i.e. the benefit of any one provision shall be given for relaxation in upper age limit.

Application Fee

Category Fee for Post 1-6 Fee for Post 7-8
Unreserved (General) category and Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan Rs.700/- Rs.1,000/-
Non-Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan and EWS of Rajasthan Rs.525/- Rs.750/-
All Specially Abled Persons and SC/ST of Rajasthan Rs.350/- Rs.500/-

Special Note:

  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan/Union Territories shall be treated as a candidate of General category and are liable to pay the examination fee as fixed for the General category candidates.
  • According to Circular dated 02.05.2018, the candidate's fee for candidates of all categories whose annual income of family is less than Rs.2.50 lakhs shall be payable same as of the candidates of SC/ST.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 20/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates shall be made through a competitive examination conducted online.
  • The merit list shall be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the examination.
  • All questions in written examination paper shall be objective type.

Examination Structure:

  • Company Secretary: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Interview (50 Marks) = Total 400 Marks
  • Assistant Town Planner: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Programmer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Junior Legal Officer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Junior Assistant: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks

Note:

  • Only those candidates who have obtained minimum qualifying marks shall be eligible for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • Maximum five times of candidates of respective vacancies of the posts shall be called for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • For Company Secretary post, candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for an interview. The number of candidates called for the interview will be five times the number of advertised vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

Reservation Policy:

  • 5% reservation shall be admissible to More Backward Class (non-creamy layer) belonging to State of Rajasthan.
  • 10% reservation shall be admissible to Economically Weaker Section of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Horizontal reservation of vacancies for women shall be 30% category-wise.
  • Out of the 30% reserved posts for women, 8% posts are reserved for widows and 2% for divorced women.
  • 2% reservation for Outstanding Sports Person (horizontal reservation).
  • Reservation for specially abled persons is also horizontal reservation.

Important Points:

  • The benefit of reserved posts of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS is only admissible to bonafide residents of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan State/Union Territories shall be treated as candidates of General category.
  • According to judgment by Supreme Court and Rajasthan High Court, a woman of a State other than Rajasthan State who becomes bonafide resident of Rajasthan State after marriage, the benefit of reservation in SC/ST/OBC/MBC category shall not be allowed to her for public employment.
  • Married female candidates of BC/MBC are required to submit certificate on the basis of father's name, residence and income. Certificate on the basis of husband shall not be valid.
  • No candidate having more than two children on or after 01.04.2007 shall be eligible for appointment to the service.
  • Registration of marriage has been made compulsory for appointment in the services of state from 22.01.2006.
  • The candidate who smokes and/or consumes gutkha will not be eligible for appointment.

Special Instructions:

  • Candidates should fill the online application carefully. No change will be possible after clicking "Complete Registration" button.
  • Prior to filling online application, candidates must go through the detailed advertisement and service rules.
  • Candidates are required to upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression and Handwritten Declaration as per guidelines.
  • Mobile phone, Bluetooth, calculator, smart watch and any other electronic/communication devices are not permitted in examination hall.
  • Call letters shall be uploaded on the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and no call letter will be sent by post.
  • Result of examination shall be communicated by uploading on the authorized website.
  • No travelling allowance/meal allowance shall be payable to candidates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates may visit the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and click on the option "Apply Online".
  • To register the application, select the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and email-id.
  • A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and sent through email and SMS.
  • Candidates can save the data by selecting "SAVE & NEXT" tab and can complete it later.
  • Before completing the registration, candidates should click on the Preview tab to preview and verify the entire application form.
  • After verifying all details, click on 'Complete Registration'.
  • Click on the 'Payment' tab and proceed for payment through online mode (Credit/Debit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets).
  • After successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form.
  • Candidates should upload:
    • Recent colour photograph (maximum one month old) - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 200 x 230 Pixels
    • Signature (scanned) - Size: 10-20 KB, Dimensions: 140 x 60 Pixels
    • Left thumb impression - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 240 x 240 pixels
    • Handwritten declaration - Size: 50-100 KB, Dimensions: 800 x 400 pixels
    • Live photograph using webcam or mobile phone
  • All documents should be in JPG/JPEG format only.
  • After successful submission, take a printout of the application form for future reference.

Note:

  • Candidates should submit their online application in the prescribed time without waiting for the last date.
  • Any change/modification may disqualify the candidate if details don't match with certificates.
  • In case of applying through e-mitra or any other source, candidate must get submission in his/her presence.

    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Advertisement

Defence Research and Development Organization Defence Laboratory (DRDO Defence Laboratory) Recruitment 2026 for 12 posts of Research Associate, Junior Research Fellow. Candidates with B.Tech/B.E, M.Sc, M.E/M.Tech, M.Phil/Ph.D Can attend the walkin. The Walk-in starts from 25-02-2026, and ends on 26-02-2026. For detailed information please visit DRDO Defence Laboratory official website, drdo.gov.in/.

DRDO DLJ RA & JRF 2026 – Important Details

Details Information
Organization Name Defence Research & Development Organization – Defence Laboratory, Jodhpur (DRDO DLJ)
Post Name Research Associate (RA – Physics) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF – Chemistry, Physics, Electronics & Communication)
Total Vacancies 12 Fellowships
Salary/Pay Scale For RA: Rs. 67,000/- per month with HRA and medical facilities as per rules (Duration: 02 years).
For JRF: Rs. 37,000/- per month with HRA and medical facilities as per rules (Duration: 02 years, may be extended further and upgraded to SRF as per rules).
Educational Qualification Ph.D./Postgraduate degree in Physics/Chemistry or B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics & Communication with NET/GATE/JEST and required experience as specified.
Age Limit RA: Not exceeding 35 years; JRF: Not exceeding 28 years (relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST/PH and 3 years for OBC).
Date of Interview 25-02-2026 and 26-02-2026
Application Mode Walk-in interview
Official Website www.drdo.gov.in

DRDO DLJ RA & JRF 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of fellowships for DRDO Defence Laboratory Jodhpur RA & JRF Recruitment 2026 is 12, distributed as follows:

Name of Fellowship Discipline Number of Fellowships
Research Associate (RA) Physics 01
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Chemistry 03
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Physics 02
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Electronics & Communication 06

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Research Associate (RA – Physics): Ph.D. in Physics or equivalent degree
    OR
    Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Physics with 03 years of Research/Teaching/Design & Development experience after post-graduation, with at least one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI) Journal.
  • JRF (Chemistry): Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Chemistry with first division and National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC (NET), MHRD (GATE) or JEST.
  • JRF (Physics): Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Physics with first division and National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC (NET), MHRD (GATE) or JEST.
  • JRF (Electronics & Communication): Graduate degree in professional course (B.E./B.Tech.) in Electronics & Communication in first division with NET/GATE qualification
    OR
    Postgraduate degree (M.E./M.Tech.) in professional courses in Electronics & Communication in first division at both graduate and postgraduate level.

Age Limit

  • RA: Age not exceeding 35 years as on the date of interview.
  • JRF: Age not exceeding 28 years as on the date of interview.
  • Relaxation: Up to 5 years for SC/ST/PH and 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates must produce original caste certificate from competent authority; PH candidates must produce a medical certificate from Government Hospital/Medical Board.

Selection Process

  • Mode of selection is walk-in interview at Defence Laboratory, Jodhpur on the dates mentioned for each fellowship.
  • Candidates must report at 10:00 Hrs on the respective date of interview.
  • Candidates are required to produce original certificates/testimonials related to age, educational qualification, experience, and copies thereof at the time of interview.
  • Candidates must also produce copies of published research papers and thesis, if applicable.
  • Offer of fellowship does not confer any right for absorption in DRDO.
  • The Research Fellowship may be terminated at any time during the tenure with a prior notice of one month; fellows may also resign with one month prior notice.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the notification.

Salary/Stipend

  • Research Associate (RA): Rs. 67,000/- per month with HRA and medical facilities as per DRDO rules; duration of fellowship is 02 years.
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- per month with HRA and medical facilities as per DRDO rules; duration of fellowship is 02 years, which may be extended further and upgraded to SRF as per rules.
  • Fellowships are purely temporary and governed by DRDO guidelines; they do not guarantee any regular appointment.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Walk-in Interview – RA (Physics) & JRF (Chemistry, Physics) 25-02-2026 at 10:00 Hrs
Walk-in Interview – JRF (Electronics & Communication) 26-02-2026 at 10:00 Hrs
Reporting Venue Defence Laboratory, Dr DS Kothari Marg, Ratanada Palace, Ratanada, Jodhpur – 342011 (Rajasthan)

How To Apply

  • Eligible Indian nationals should appear directly for the walk-in interview at Defence Laboratory, Dr DS Kothari Marg, Ratanada Palace, Ratanada, Jodhpur – 342011, Rajasthan at 10:00 Hrs on the respective interview date.
  • Prepare a complete Bio-Data with a recent passport size photograph affixed on the top right corner of the first page.
  • Bring one set of self-attested copies and original documents of all degrees, academic qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, and other relevant documents.
  • Carry copies of published research papers and thesis, if applicable.
  • Candidates working in Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Autonomous Bodies must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer at the time of interview.
  • No prior online application is prescribed; selection is purely through walk-in on the scheduled dates.

Instructions

  • Fellowships are purely temporary; they do not confer any right for absorption or regular appointment in DRDO.
  • The Research Fellowship can be terminated at any time during the tenure with one month prior notice from either side.
  • Defence Laboratory, Jodhpur reserves the right to amend, modify or cancel the advertisement, and the number of fellowships may be increased, decreased or cancelled depending upon prevailing requirements and Government of India policies.
  • Candidates must ensure they meet the age, qualification and other eligibility conditions as on the date of interview.
  • Candidates must bring all required original documents and self-attested copies; failure to produce documents may lead to disqualification.
  • No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.
  • For any clarifications, candidates may contact HR Division on 0291-2567406/409/410 or email: [email protected].
