Date of Publication of the Notification 02 February 2026
Starting Date for submission of Application 07 February 2026
Closing Date for Submission of Application 28 February 2026
Download of Hall Tickets for Skill Test in Driving Date will be intimated later
Date of Skill Test in Driving April 2026

Selection Process

  • A skill test in driving will be conducted to the shortlisted candidates. The mode and other particulars of the same will be
  • The minimum qualifying marks to be secured in the Skill Test will be 45% for OC/EWS, 40% to the BC candidates and 35% for SC, ST
  • The candidates qualified in the Skill Test will be shortlisted in the ratio of 1:3 of the notified/available vacancies for certificate verification prior to the oral interview (Viva-voce) and the candidates who are eligible will be called for oral interview from the said ratio
  • Weightage marks will be given to the candidates presently working on contract or outsourcing basis in the Service of the High Court for the State of Telangana: Head Office of the Telangana State Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad; the Telangana High Court Legal Services Committee, Hyderabad; the Telangana Judicial Ministerial and Subordinate Service; the District Legal Services Authority and in the Mandal Legal Services Committees in the State of Telangana, based on the length of the service they have rendered. Provided, i. they have put in at least two years of service by the date of publication of this notification; and ii. they have secured minimum qualifying marks in the skill test, as prescribed above
  • No person shall be eligible for appointment to the service by Direct Recruitment unless he/she satisfies the following conditions viz., i. That he/she is of sound health and active habits. ii. That his/her character and antecedents are such as to qualify him/her for such service; and iii. He/she is a citizen of India
  • Merit list will be based on the consolidated marks obtained by the candidates in the skill test and viva-voce
  • Where two or more candidates get equal number of consolidated marks in the said Skill Test and oral interview, the elder in age will be considered for provisional selection. In case of a tie in age also, the candidate with highest marks in the prescribed educational qualification i.e., SSC, would be considered

General Information / Instructions

  • The particulars furnished by the applicant in the application form submitted to the High Court will be taken as final. Candidates should, therefore, be very careful in filling the application.
  • No T.A. and D.A. will be paid to the candidates who appear for the Skill Test in Driving or for verification of original certificates or for the Viva-voce.
  • Mere applying and mere securing minimum qualifying marks in the Skill Test will not give any vested right to any candidate to be selected.
  • All rights are reserved with the appointing authority to reject the application at any stage, if the claim is found to be false and the appointment shall liable to be cancelled if any information therein is found to be false at any later stage and the applicants are liable for prosecution for furnishing such false information.
  • Selection will be made as per the Service Rules of the High Court for the State of Telangana, 2019 (as amended from time to time).
  • Candidates resorting to bring any influence of any kind will be summarily disqualified.
  • No person who has more than one wife living or who has spouse living, marries in any case, in which such marriage is void by reason of its taking place during the life time of such spouse, shall be eligible for appointment by direct recruitment.
  • No person who has been dismissed from a State or Central Government service or from the service of Central or State Government undertaking or local or other authorities or who has been convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude shall be eligible for appointment to the post.
  • This appointment shall be covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS).
  • No information will be sent to the unsuccessful candidates after announcement of the list of provisionally selected candidates.
  • All rights are reserved with the appointing authority to cancel the provisional selection of the candidates if the certificates of the provisionally selected candidates such as eligibility, educational qualification, and social status etc., are found to be in correct at any stage of the recruitment.
  • The prescribed Form of Application can be downloaded from the High Courts' website, viz., https://tshc.gov.in and print the same on a A4 size copy paper for the purpose of filling-in and submission.
  • Help Desk (Help Desk will function on all working days): i. Help Desk Land Line Telephone No.040-23688394. ii. Help Desk Email ID: [email protected]. iii. Working hours of Help Desk Office: From 10.30 A.M to 5.00P.M iv. Lunch Break: 1.30 P.M. to 2.30 P.M.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited in the proforma application enclosed to this notification
  • The duly filled in applications should be sent by Speed post/ Courier or in person, duly superscribing on envelop as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DRIVER- 2026", to the Registrar (Recruitment), High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad - 500 066, on or before 28.02.2026 by 05:00 PM (Two separate self-addressed envelopes for communication to the applicant by the High Court, are also required to be submitted along with this application.)
  • Attested (to be attested by a Gazetted Officer) copies of certificates of prescribed academic qualification, such as, marks lists, pass certificate, certificate evidencing date of birth, Valid Driving Licence issued by competent authority substantiating the eligibility criteria as prescribed in this notification, caste certificate and relevant experience certificate
  • One passport size photograph is to be pasted on the application at right top corner. Further the applicants shall include 2 passport size photographs (not to be attested and not to be pasted anywhere on the application) along with the application. All three photographs shall be latest and identical
  • No-objection Certificate from the Employer (if employed anywhere)
  • After publication of the list of provisionally selected candidates, they will be called for original certificates verification on a date fixed for this purpose. They shall produce all the relevant original certificates on the prescribed date. If any candidate fails to produce any of the required certificates, his/her candidature will be rejected without any further correspondence
  • The unsigned, not properly filled and the applications received without necessary enclosures will be summarily rejected and applications received after the due date, for any reasons will not be entertained. Information will be sent to all the eligible applicants about the date, time and venue of Skill Test to be conducted. The information will also be placed in the website of the High Court

The certificates and/or mark sheets of educational qualifications, including SSC, Intermediate, Diploma, UG Degree, PG Degree, and PhD, along with the consolidated mark sheet of the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the post applied. b. NOC from current employer, if applicable. Salary certificates for all the experiences of the candidate should be submitted. These Certificates should contain a breakup of the salary so as to enable us to compare with the scales of pay of the Government indicated against each post wherever required. g. Certificate of proficiency should be submitted, wherever required, with respect to desirable qualifications.

Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 – Complete Guide

The Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026 is designed to certify the eligibility of in-service teachers for teaching positions in Classes 1 to 8. Conducted by the Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB) under the Government of Tamil Nadu, it targets working teachers appointed before a specified cutoff date. The exam is held in offline mode using OMR sheets, with two separate papers: Paper 1 for Classes 1–5 and Paper 2 for Classes 6–8.

What is Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test for Working Teachers 2026?

TET is a state-level eligibility test for teachers of Classes 1–8 in government and aided schools, ensuring they meet national standards for teaching aptitude and subject knowledge. The 2026 version includes a special focus on working teachers who have not yet cleared TET, aligning with government and Supreme Court directives to make it mandatory for all educators. Clearing TET is now essential for job security and career advancement in Tamil Nadu.

  • Conducting body: Teachers Recruitment Board (TRB), Government of Tamil Nadu
  • Level: State-level eligibility test
  • Applicable classes: Paper 1 – Classes 1–5, Paper 2 – Classes 6–8

Special TET 2026 for Working Teachers – Key Highlights

This special TET targets working teachers, offering a dedicated chance to qualify without competing with fresh candidates. It differs by restricting eligibility to in-service educators, emphasizing their need for TET clearance for promotions and regularization. The test follows the standard TNTET pattern and syllabus.

Eligibility Criteria for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Eligibility is limited to working teachers appointed on or before 01.09.2025 as Secondary Grade Teachers (SGT), BT Assistants, or equivalent cadres on time scale, consolidated, or part-time pay in specified departments and schools.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Classes 1–5)

Candidates must possess the qualifications as per G.O.(Ms).No.13, School Education [SE3(1)] Department, dated 30.01.2020, including 10+2/HSC plus Diploma in Teacher Education/Diploma in Elementary Education or equivalent. This applies to Secondary Grade Teachers, BRTEs, and Special Education Teachers (IEDSS). In-service teachers in aided or unaided schools are also eligible if they meet NCTE norms.

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Classes 6–8)

Graduation in the relevant subject plus B.Ed. or equivalent, as per special rules for Tamil Nadu School Educational Subordinate Services. For Special Education Teachers, qualifications from G.O.(Ms).No.144, dated 17.06.2025 apply. Subject-specific requirements include relevant graduation for Mathematics/Science or Social Science teachers.

Age Limit and In-Service Relaxations

There is no upper age limit specified for TET eligibility. Relaxations in qualifying marks apply: 50% for BC/BCM/MBC/DNC/PWD and 40% for SC/SCA/ST.

Who Can Apply as a Working Teacher?

In-service teachers in government, government-aided, and recognized unaided private schools teaching Classes 1 to 8, including those under various departments like School Education, MBC, ADW, Tribal Welfare, and corporations. Qualified serving teachers opting for promotion must also apply.

TN TET 2026 Exam Pattern for Working Teachers

The exam pattern is identical for working and non-working candidates: 150 MCQs, 3 hours duration, no negative marking.

Minimum Qualifying Marks for Working Teachers

General category: 60% (90/150). BC/BCM/MBC/DNC and PWD: 50% (75/150). SC/SCA/ST: 40% (60/150).

Tamil Nadu TET 2026 Syllabus for Working Teachers

The syllabus is based on the state-prescribed topics for Classes 1–8, with difficulty up to secondary/higher secondary stage.

TNTET 2026 Paper 1 Syllabus (Classes 1–5)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy: Stages of child development, learning theories, inclusive education, teaching–learning process, assessment and evaluation.
  • Language I (regional language): Reading comprehension, grammar, language skills, pedagogy of language development.
  • Language II – English: Comprehension, vocabulary, grammar, communication, English language pedagogy.
  • Mathematics: Number system, operations, fractions, decimals, geometry, measurement, data handling, pedagogy of mathematics.
  • Environmental Studies: Family and friends, food, water, travel, shelter, environment, resources, EVS pedagogy.

TNTET 2026 Paper 2 Syllabus (Classes 6–8)

  • Child Development and Pedagogy (11–14): Adolescent development, learning and motivation, classroom management, evaluation.
  • Language I and II: Similar components as Paper 1 but at higher difficulty level.
  • Subject-specific: Mathematics & Science – algebra, geometry, mensuration, statistics, basics of physics, chemistry, biology, pedagogy. Social Science – history, geography, civics, economics, social science pedagogy.

Note that the official TRB syllabus PDF must be followed strictly.

Application Process for Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 (Working Teachers)

Applications are online only via http://www.trb.tn.gov.in. Separate applications for Paper 1 and Paper 2 with fees.

  • Register with valid email and mobile number.
  • Fill details, upload photo (40-60 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (20-40 KB), and certificates (250-300 KB PDF).
  • Pay fee: Rs.600/- (general) or Rs.300/- (SC/SCA/ST/PWD) via net banking/credit/debit card.
  • Use edit window if needed; submit by 10-04-2026.

Documents required:

  • 10th/SSLC, 12th/HSC, Diploma/B.Ed./UG certificates and mark sheets.
  • Community certificate, Differently Abled certificate.
  • Service Certificate (Annexure-I).

Exam Centres, Hall Ticket and Exam Day Guidelines

Exams in all districts; centre details in hall ticket. Download hall ticket from TRB website. Report early with ID proof; no electronic gadgets allowed. OMR-based; follow invigilator instructions.

TN TET 2026 Result, Certificate Validity and Use for Promotions

Results published on http://www.trb.tn.gov.in as qualified lists. Qualifying candidates receive TNTET certificates. Validity is lifetime as per norms. For working teachers, TET clearance is mandatory for promotions in Tamil Nadu government schools; it's an eligibility criterion for career progression.

Benefits of Clearing Tamil Nadu TET 2026 for Working Teachers

  • Eligibility for regularization and promotions in government and aided schools.
  • Compliance with Supreme Court directions making TET mandatory for Classes 1–8 teachers.
  • Better job security and mobility, eligibility for future recruitment drives.
  • Professional recognition and alignment with national teacher quality standards.

Preparation Strategy for Working Teachers – How to Crack TN TET 2026

Balance school duties with study by focusing on pedagogy sections. Use NCERT/Tamil Nadu textbooks for content revision.

  • Create a weekly timetable around school hours.
  • Revise core concepts from textbook levels you teach daily.
  • Use weekends for full-length mock tests.
  • Focus on weak sections identified from previous attempts.

12th (+2 stage) or its equivalent examination with not less than 50% marks in the aggregate. 50% marks will not be insisted upon in case of SC / ST /PwBD/ Ex-Servicemen. or Pass in Matriculation or its equivalent from a recognized Board and having ITI / Act Apprenticeship in relevant trades.

  • b) Prizes won at National level.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Level-2 of 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC)

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 30 years
  • The upper age is relaxable by 03 years for candidates belonging to OBC communities and by 05 years for candidates belonging to SC/ST communities.
  • Upto the extent of service in Defence plus 3 years for Ex-Servicemen provided they have put in more than 6 months service after attestation.
  • By 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (13 years for OBC and 15 years for SC/ST)
  • Upper age limit for widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from husband but not remarried shall be 35 years for UR, 38 years for OBC and 40 years for SC / ST.
  • For serving Railway Staff, Casual labourers and Substitutes, the upper age limit will be 40 years for UR, 43 years for OBC and 45 years for SC/ST, provided they have put in a minimum of 3 years service.
  • For those working in Quasi-Administrative offices of the Railway, the upper age relaxation will be up to the length of service, subject to a maximum of 5 years.

Application Fee

  • Examination fee should be paid online through Internet Banking or Debit or Credit Cards (service charges for payment of fees will be borne by the candidates).
  • Fee Rs. 500/- for all candidates, except the Fee concession categories.
  • Fee Rs. 250/- for candidates belonging to SC/ST/Ex-servicemen/Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes with a provision for refunding the same, duly deducting bank charges, if any, to those candidates while appearing in the Written test / Practical Demonstration.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 29/01/2026
Opening date and time for receipt of application 29.01.2026 / 09.00 hrs.
Closing date and time for receipt of application 28.02.2026 / 23.59 hrs.
Written Test and Practical demonstration March 2026

Selection Process

  • The candidates who apply in response to this notification and are found eligible for consideration for appointment against cultural quota will be assessed based on their performance in Written Test and Practical demonstration.
  • The eligible candidates will be called for Written Test and qualified candidates will be called for document verification/Practical demonstration.
  • a) Written Test 50 Marks
  • b) Assessment of Talent in the relevant field on (i) The basis of Practical Demonstration 35 marks (ii) Testimonials / Prizes etc. 15 marks
  • Only those candidates who secure the qualifying marks in the written test will be called for "Assessment of Talent" in the relevant field. Panel will be prepared in order of merit according to marks obtained out of 100.
  • Selected candidates will have to undergo medical examination and found fit for the medical classification prescribed for the post for which, he/she is being considered.

General Information/Instructions

  • The above posts are open to all candidates in possession of the notified qualification of education, age etc. The candidates who belong to SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen categories are extended relaxation in upper age limit as admissible in general open market recruitments.
  • The Administration reserves the right of allotment of posts in any cadre to the selected candidates according to its requirement irrespective of the qualification of the candidates.
  • The decision of the Administration is final and request for change of post /trade at a later date will not be entertained.
  • Educational Boards / Schools set up by the Council of Boards of School Education (COBSE) is not recognized one, as per Railway Board's letter No. RBE No.114/2017 dated 31.08.2017.
  • Further, the Certificates / Degrees issued from Jharkhand State Open School, Ranchi is also not recognized one for the purpose of employment / promotion in Railways, as per Railway Board's letter No.E(NG)II/2021/RR-1/41 dated 29.09.2021.
  • List of eligible candidates will be published in the website.
  • Candidates who qualify in the Written test will be called for Document Verification/Practical demonstration.
  • Document verification will be done one day prior to the date of Practical demonstration.
  • The candidates, who are recruited against Cultural Quota, shall perform Cultural programmes in Railways, for a minimum period of 10 years, for which, they shall execute a bond.
  • All SMS communications from ICF Administration will be from PB ICF.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check the website https://pb.icf.gov.in for updates. In case of any clarification, candidates may raise issues in the helpdesk given at https://pb.icf.gov.in/cultural_26/HELPDESK_ENTRY.PHP. No other mode of communication will be entertained. Any violation will be viewed seriously.
  • All SMS communications from ICF Administration will be from PB ICF.
  • Candidates may note that submission of fake / forged documents or providing false information will lead to cancellation of candidature / termination of service without any notice at any stage i.e. Written test / Practical demonstration / Empanelment / after Appointment. Further, such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification of the candidature.
  • Candidates must ensure that they must upload soft copies of the relevant Cultural, Educational Qualifications, photograph, LTI/RTI, Signature etc as required. Incomplete applications and applications uploaded without requisite documents / LTI/RTI will be summarily rejected and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Mere calling for Written Test / Practical Demonstration will not be a guarantee for appointment.
  • ICF Administration has not appointed any agents or coaching centres for acting on its behalf. Beware of such persons/agencies. Recruitment is done strictly as per merit.
  • Legal issues, if any, shall fall within the territorial jurisdiction of the Central Administrative Tribunal Chennai under which this Administration is located.
  • The mobile number and E-Mail ID should not be changed by the candidates till completion of selection and administration will not be responsible for non-receipt of communication if mobile number and e-mail ID are changed in between.
  • The Railway Administration is not responsible for any delay in delivery /non-receipt of e-mail or SMS. Candidates should also check their spam e-mail folder.
  • Candidates, who are already in service of PSU/Government Organizations and are eligible for the above, should produce "No Objection Certificate" for the same from their employer at the time of Document Verification.
  • Application without paying or paying less examination fee than prescribed by this Notification will be rejected.

How to Apply

  • Facility for submission of online application will be available from 29/01/2026 to 28/02/2026 till 23:59 hrs on ICF website https://pb.icf.gov.in
  • Application will be accepted only through Online mode.
  • Candidates who wish to apply need to log on to the ICF web portal https://pb.icf.gov.in
  • Candidates should read the notification thoroughly and fill in the online application form carefully and correctly. No corrections in the application will be permitted once the application is submitted. Candidates can submit only one application, submission of multiple applications will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Before filling the application form, candidates should keep ready all the relevant documents/certificates and image of recent passport size photograph (not more than 200 KB) in JPG format and to upload the photograph with clear front view of the candidate without cap and sunglasses.
  • The applicant has to sign and affix LTU/RTI (lines on finger should be clear/visible and should not be smudged) on white paper with Black Ink within a box of size 50 mm x 20 mm respectively and upload. The images should be in JPG format scanned with 100 dpi resolution, size of file should not be more than 200 KB. The scanned signature should be, either in English or Hindi, and in running hand and not in BLOCK/CAPITAL or disjointed letter.
  • System generated registration number is the candidate's individual Registration ID. The password to generate application printout is the Date of Birth. For login purpose, candidates should use this registration number generated. The password will be date of birth in "ddmmyyyy" format.
  • Candidates are advised to check whether the details fed by them are correct in the preview and make corrections, if any. Once application is submitted, no further corrections are permitted.
  • Candidates are NOT required to send / submit any documents including system generated application form to ICF through Post/e-mail/FAX/By hand.
  • After final submission, candidates can take a printout of the online application. They are advised to bring the printout of the online application at the time of Written Test.
  • Candidates are required to upload the following legible documents. Candidature will be rejected, in case of uploading of documents which are not clear. Decision of administration will be final. No communication will be entertained.
  • Scanned self-attested copy of Educational Qualification certificate, as prescribed in Para-2 of the notification.
  • Scanned self-attested copy of essential minimum prescribed Cultural qualification certificate, as prescribed in Para 3.1 to 3.3 of the notification. Candidates are advised to avoid uploading certificates other than specified norms.
  • Self-attested copy of caste / community certificate in prescribed format issued by the competent authority for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates.
  • Self-attested copy of discharge certificate for Ex-servicemen candidates.
  • Any certificate, photograph etc. sent separately after uploading of Application Form will not be entertained.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

  • As per CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024, engagement of Project Staff shall be co-terminus with the term of the Project subject to the condition that the total period of the engagement of a Project Staff in different projects either in the same Lab/Instt. Or different Lab/Instt. of CSIR taken together shall not exceed 6 years in any case. Hence, the applicants who have completed the total tenure of 6 years in any of the CSIR Lab/Instt. As Project Staff are NOT ELIGIBLE to apply for the aforesaid positions.
  • Reporting Time: 08.30 A.M. at the venue. No Candidate will be allowed to enter into the Venue after 10.00 A.M.
  • The relaxation in the age limit for the candidates belonging to the category of SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/ Women and category if OBC shall be 05 years and 03 years respectively or as per Govt. of India instructions issued in this regard from time to time.
  • If all things are equal, SC/ST/OBC/EWS Candidates may be given preference over General Candidates to ensure due representation.
  • Final Semester/Year students who are awaiting results are not eligible to be considered.
  • The date of determining the qualification and age limit shall be on the date of interview.
  • In case of Universities/Institutes awarding CGPA/SGPA/OGPA Grades etc., candidates are requested to convert the same into percentage based on the formula as per their University/Institute (copy of documented proof of the conversion factor may be attached).
  • Number of Positions required is indicative in nature; there may be an increase/decrease in the number based on requirement (s).
  • Candidates selected will be provided either accommodation in the Institute Campus (if available) or shall be paid HRA (as applicable).
  • Tenure mentioned above in any case will be co-terminus with the project or till such time this requirement exists whichever is earlier.
  • The engagement of Project Personnel is purely on temporary basis, initially for a period of six months which may be extended or curtailed depending on the tenure of the Project/satisfactory performance or conduct of the appointee as the case may be and does not confer any right/claim implicit or explicit on any candidate for claiming extension or absorption in CSIR-CECRI.
  • If it is found at any stage of the process or thereafter that the candidate does not fulfill the eligibility criteria their candidature shall be cancelled without assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Filling up of the positions is solely at the discretion of the Director, CSIR-CECRI, Karaikudi based on suitability of candidates and no claim will arise for engagement, if some of these positions are not filled due to unsuitability / insufficient number of candidates. The decision of the Director, CSIR- CECRI, Karaikudi will be final and binding on all candidates and on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process either in part or full, etc.
  • Any queries regarding Project Personnel engagement, Please contact office numbers – 04565 – 241219/218 during office hours (09:00 A.M. to 05:30 P.M.) or mails may be addressed to ([email protected]). No calls/mails will be entertained other than the above-mentioned office telephone numbers/email id.
  • Candidates are advised to check the official CECRI website https://www.cecri.res.in/ regularly for addendum/corrigendum and updated information regarding this. Therefore, candidates are advised to keep visiting regularly the website of CSIR-CECRI

Important Instructions

  • Eligibility Date: Criteria reckoned as on 27-02-2026 (application closing date)
  • Document Verification: Original certificates must be produced at the time of verification/interview
  • Disqualification Grounds:
  • • Incomplete applications
  • • Incorrect/mismatched information
  • • Signature/photograph variations
  • • Non-payment or incorrect fee payment
  • • Late receipt of hard copy (after 10-03-2026)
  • • False/fake certificates
  • • Use of unfair means in examination
  • Employed Candidates: Must submit No Objection Certificate from employer in hard copy at document verification
  • PwBD Candidates: Must inform about required assistance at least 10 days before examination
  • No TA/DA: Candidates bear own travel expenses for examination/interview
  • Merit-Based Selection: Mere fulfillment of qualifications does not guarantee selection

  • Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification
  • No interim inquiries entertained; updates available only on CSU website
  • Territorial jurisdiction: Delhi High Court for any legal disputes

Zone-wise Recruitment Details

Candidates can apply in only ONE zone for each post category. However, candidates are free to choose different zones for different post categories. For example, a candidate can apply for LDC in Zone-1 and UDC in Zone-3, but cannot apply for LDC in both Zone-1 and Zone-3.

Zone Definition: Zones are designed for institutional stability and continuity. There is no domicile restriction—any candidate can apply to any zone. Selected candidates will be allotted to institutions within their chosen zone based on merit and preference.

  • Student Counselling: Provide academic and personal counselling to students on matters related to academics, career, and campus life

  • Event Coordination: Assist in organizing campus events, workshops, seminars related to student development

Application Process

  • Late/Extended Submissions: Not accepted under any circumstances

Documents to be Uploaded (Scanned Copies)

While applying online, candidates must upload scanned copies of the following original documents/certificates:

  • 1. SSLC Certificate: As proof of Date of Birth
  • 2. Educational Qualification Certificates: Master's degree certificate with final marks sheet as specified for the position (Social Sciences/MBA/English Literature)
  • 3. Bachelor's Degree Certificate: With marks sheet
  • 4. Experience Certificate: From all employers in chronological order (latest employment to earlier ones) mentioning:

  • • Nature of duties
  • • Designation held

  • • Electoral Identity Card (Voter ID)
  • • Aadhaar Card

  • All documents must be clear, legible, and properly scanned
  • Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected
  • Applications without supporting documents will be rejected
  • Applications not submitted in the prescribed format will be rejected
  • Possession of minimum qualifications does not guarantee interview call
  • Selection Committee reserves right to fix additional criteria for selection

  • Stage 1 - Application Review: Verification that qualifications and experience meet minimum criteria
  • Stage 2 - Shortlisting: Merit-based shortlisting of eligible candidates
  • Stage 3 - Interview: Candidates will be called for interview only (no written examination)
  • Stage 4 - Document Verification: At the time of interview, certificate verification will be conducted
  • Stage 5 - Final Selection: Based on interview performance and document verification

  • Interview date, time, and venue will be communicated to selected candidates
  • Candidates must regularly visit the official website for updates
  • No separate telephone/interim enquiries regarding interview will be entertained

    Email: [email protected] and [email protected]
  • Age Calculation: For age verification, the closing date of application (10-03-2026) will be taken into account

  • Canvassing Prohibition: Any form of canvassing will result in disqualification from the selection process
  • Director's Authority: In all matters relating to conduct, selection, appointment, and pay, the decision of Director (IIMK) shall be final and binding

2. Apprenticeship Status

  • Candidates currently undergoing Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any Govt./Public Sector/Private industrial establishment are NOT eligible.
  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training in IREL or any other organization are not eligible.

3. Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 25 years as on the last date of application.
  • Age relaxation: SC/ST up to 5 years; OBC (NCL) up to 3 years; PWBD up to 10 years.

Age Limit

  • As on the last date of application, the candidate should be between 18 and 25 years of age.
  • Relaxation in upper age limit is applicable as per Government guidelines: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC (NCL) – 3 years; PWBD – 10 years.
  • Proof of age must be supported by Matriculation/10th certificate or Birth Certificate.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on merit list prepared from marks scored in the specified educational qualification, subject to being found “Medically Fit” by the company’s authorised Doctor.
  • In case of tie, higher marks in the qualifying exam will be considered; if still equal, elder candidate (earlier date of birth) will be given preference.
  • Priority order for selection at Rare Earths Division:
    • Candidates belonging to Land Affected Category (if applicable, with documentary proof).
    • Candidates from peripheral villages within 10 km radius of RED and wards of serving/deceased employees of IREL.
    • Candidates from Ernakulam District.
    • Candidates from Kerala State.
    • Others.
  • Merit list candidates will be called for document verification; originals and self-attested photocopies of all required documents must be produced.
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo medical examination and be declared “Medically Fit” before engagement.
  • Entry to RED, a highly protected area, requires submission of Police Verification Certificate from the concerned Police authorities prior to joining.
  • Final selection and department allocation within the unit are at the discretion of management; there is no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship.

Application Fee

The advertisement does not specify any application fee for engagement of apprentices at IREL Rare Earths Division.

    • 10th Mark Sheet.
    • SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/Disability certificates (as applicable) in prescribed format.
    • Declaration form for OBC-NCL, if applicable.
    • All semester/year-wise mark sheets and final certificate of ITI/Diploma/Degree, as applicable to the apprentice category.
    • Nativity Certificate.
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • Proof of enrollment/registration in the respective apprenticeship portal (NATS/NAPS).
  5. Email Submission: Send the scanned copy of duly filled application form affixed with passport size photograph along with all supporting documents to [email protected].
  6. Subject Line: Mention in email subject: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES AGAINST NOTIFICATION NO. IREL/RED/HRM/Apprentices Engagement/2026-27/01”.

Assistant Foreman (Mechanical) (Trainee) Grade-C a) Matriculate or equivalent examination passed from any recognized Board of examination;
b) Diploma or relevant and higher qualification (Minimum 3 years course) in Mechanical Engineering from any institute recognized by the Government.
Assistant Foreman (Electrical) (Trainee) Grade-C a) Matriculate or equivalent examination passed from any recognized Board of examination;
b) Diploma or relevant and higher qualification (Minimum 3 years course) in Electrical Engineering from any institute recognized by the Government.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 18 Years (as on 05-03-2026)
  • Upper Age Limit: 30 Years (as on 05-03-2026)
  • Age relaxation as per Government rules: SC/ST - 5 Years, OBC(NCL) - 3 Years, PwBD (UR) - 10 Years, PwBD (OBC-NCL) - 13 Years, PwBD (SC/ST) - 15 Years, Ex-Servicemen - Actual service + 3 Years (up to 50 Years max for SC/ST/OBC), Departmental Candidates - No upper limit

Application Fee

Category Fee
For UR / EWS / OBC (NCL) Rs. 1180/- (Rs. 1000 + Rs. 180 GST)
For SC / ST / PwBD / ESM / Departmental Candidates Nil

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates meeting the minimum eligibility criteria as on the Crucial Date will be required to appear for a Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • Selection will be based on a candidate's relative score in the Computer Based Test.
  • CBT Pattern: Total 100 Marks for 90 minutes duration (one sitting), comprising two sections:
    • Section A: Technical Knowledge (discipline related) – 70 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) of 1 mark each – 70 Marks.
    • Section B: General Knowledge, General Awareness, Reasoning, Verbal & Mental Ability, and Quantitative Aptitude – 30 MCQs of 1 mark each – 30 Marks.
    • Each question carries 01 mark. There is no penalty for wrong answers. No marks for un-attempted questions.
    • Question paper will be bilingual (English and Hindi). In case of any error/ambiguity in Hindi version, the English version shall be valid and final.
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks (Cut-Off):
    • UR / EWS: 50 marks out of 100
    • SC / ST / ESM / OBC-NCL / PwBD: 40 marks out of 100
  • Computer Based Test will be conducted separately for each post.
  • Tie-Breaking Rule: In case of equal marks, tie will be resolved by: (i) Higher score in Section-A; then (ii) Date of Birth – older candidates preferred; then (iii) Alphabetical order of names.
  • Candidates who score equal to or above Minimum Qualifying Marks will be notified for Scrutiny/Verification of original testimonials in the order of marks scored, up to the extent positions remain unfilled.
  • Provisional merit panels will be published on NCL website after resolving ties, separately for different positions.
  • For Assistant Foreman (Mechanical) and Assistant Foreman (Electrical), all candidates will be deemed to have applied for both Excavation Cadre and E&M Cadre. Separate merit lists for each cadre will be prepared; Excavation Cadre merit panel will be prepared first, followed by E&M Cadre with remaining candidates.
  • Provisional appointment letters will be issued to successful candidates as per their relative merit position and eligibility, with due consideration of reservation.
  • If candidate is found not fulfilling eligibility criteria during Scrutiny/Verification, Probation, or during employment, candidature/appointment shall be cancelled.
  • Appointment is subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination as per CIL's laid down rules.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 09/02/2026
Start Date of Online Registration and Form Submission 11/02/2026 (10:00 AM)
Closing Date for Online Registration and Form Submission (Crucial Date) 05/03/2026 (11:59 PM)
Tentative Date of Downloading Admit Card for Eligible Candidates Will be intimated through official website
Tentative Date of Computer Based Test (CBT) Will be intimated through official website
Tentative Date of Declaration of Result Will be intimated through official website

Selection Process

How to Apply

  • Visit the official NCL website: www.nclcil.in
  • Navigate to: Career > Recruitment > Employment Notification for Direct Recruitment of various posts of Supervisory Staff i.e. Assistant Foreman (Mechanical / E&T / Electrical) > Apply Online.
  • Employment Notification is available in both English and Hindi; candidates may select either at their convenience.
  • Go through the complete Employment Notification carefully for assessing eligibility before applying.
  • Candidates (other than SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental Candidates) must pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 1,180/- through online facility only.
  • While applying online, candidates must upload the following documents:
    • Scanned copy of recent passport-size colour photograph (not older than 3 weeks, in jpg/jpeg format).
    • Scanned copy of signature with black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format).
    • Scanned copy of Matriculation / Secondary Board level certificate / marksheet.
    • Scanned copy of Diploma or relevant and higher qualification in the respective engineering discipline (Electronics / Mechanical / Electrical) from a Government recognized institute.
    • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / SC / ST / PwBD candidates: self-attested copy of valid certificate in prescribed format.
    • EWS candidates: self-attested copy of valid Income & Asset certificate issued by competent authority on the basis of gross annual income of Financial Year 2024-2025.
  • A candidate can apply for any one of the three positions only. Applying for multiple positions will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • If more than one application is received from a candidate, the most recent (current) application will be considered as final.
  • After filling all required fields, ensure all data furnished is correct before submitting the form; no change is allowed after submission.
  • Keep a printout of the online application for future reference.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last-minute network congestion.
  • No hard copies of online application or copies of testimonials need to be posted/dispatched.
  • Last Date: 05/03/2026 (11:59 PM)

How to Apply

  • Visit the official CSU recruitment portal: https://csu.co.in/adarsh_nt/
  • Register with your email ID and mobile number
  • Fill the online application form with accurate details
  • Select your preferred zone and institution from the available options
  • Choose examination centre (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, or Chennai)
  • For multiple posts: Apply separately if choosing different post categories or zones, paying individual fees for each

    The Registrar
    Central Sanskrit University
    56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri
    New Delhi - 110058
    Latest by 10-03-2026 at 6:00 PM IST by registered post
  • Preserve application receipt and printout for future reference

  • Self-attested copies of all supporting documents:
  • • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • • Experience certificates
  • • Proof of date of birth
  • • Government-issued photo ID proof
  • • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) if applicable
  • • No Objection Certificate from current employer (if government employee)
  • • NET/SLET/SET certificate (for College Librarian post)
  • Publication list (for applicable posts)

Important Instructions

  • Dual Requirement: Both online submission AND hard copy must reach by specified deadlines. Applications failing either requirement will be rejected
  • Multiple Applications: Candidates can apply for different post categories but only ONE per category per zone. Applying for same post in different zones is NOT allowed for same category
  • Examination Centres: Available at Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai. Candidates may choose any centre regardless of zone applied
  • Eligibility Date: Criteria reckoned as on 27-02-2026 (application closing date)
  • Document Verification: Original certificates must be produced at the time of verification/interview
  • Disqualification Grounds:
  • • Incomplete applications
  • • Incorrect/mismatched information
  • • Signature/photograph variations
  • • Non-payment or incorrect fee payment
  • • Late receipt of hard copy (after 10-03-2026)
  • • False/fake certificates
  • • Use of unfair means in examination
  • Employed Candidates: Must submit No Objection Certificate from employer in hard copy at document verification
  • PwBD Candidates: Must inform about required assistance at least 10 days before examination
  • No TA/DA: Candidates bear own travel expenses for examination/interview
  • Merit-Based Selection: Mere fulfillment of qualifications does not guarantee selection
  • CSU reserves right to cancel, modify, or withdraw vacancy at any stage
  • Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification
  • No interim inquiries entertained; updates available only on CSU website
  • Territorial jurisdiction: Delhi High Court for any legal disputes

Zone-wise Recruitment Details

Candidates can apply in only ONE zone for each post category. However, candidates are free to choose different zones for different post categories. For example, a candidate can apply for LDC in Zone-1 and UDC in Zone-3, but cannot apply for LDC in both Zone-1 and Zone-3.

Zone Definition: Zones are designed for institutional stability and continuity. There is no domicile restriction—any candidate can apply to any zone. Selected candidates will be allotted to institutions within their chosen zone based on merit and preference.

How to Apply – Step by Step

  1. Visit the AMU careers portal at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in and select Advertisement No. 3/2026/NT.
  2. Register/login and fill the online application form with complete personal, educational and experience details.
  3. Pay the application fee of Rs 500 per post online (PwD candidates are exempt).
  4. Submit the form and download/print the filled application form.
  5. Paste a recent passport-size photograph and sign in the designated spaces on the printout.
  6. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (educational certificates, experience, caste/PwD, NOC etc.).
  7. Send the hardcopy application along with enclosures to the specified address by Speed Post or submit in person so that it reaches on or before 30-03-2026 (5:00 PM).

Documents Required

  • High School (10th) marksheet and certificate.
  • Intermediate/12th marksheet and certificate.
  • Graduation marksheets and degree.
  • Postgraduation marksheets and degree, if applicable.
  • Experience certificates mentioning appointment date, duration, pay scale/pay band/pay level.
  • Caste/Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer), if applicable.
  • Disability certificate in prescribed format for PwD candidates.
  • Any other certificates supporting essential or desirable qualifications.
  • Recent passport-size photograph.
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer for in-service candidates.

Key Eligibility Highlights (Post-wise Summary)

Below is a brief HTML-ready summary of essential qualifications and experience for each post; candidates must refer to the full advertisement before applying.

  • Senior Instrument Officer (Chemistry): Ph.D. in Chemistry with 8 years’ experience in operation, data analysis, maintenance and repair of sophisticated instruments (NMR, MASS, EPR, IR, CD, ORD spectrometers, GC-MS, UV-Vis), OR M.Sc. in Chemistry with 12 years’ similar experience; one-year computer applications diploma desirable.
  • Junior Instrument Officer (Chemistry): Ph.D. in Chemistry with 4 years’ relevant instrument experience OR M.Sc. in Chemistry (minimum 50% marks) with 6 years’ similar experience; one-year computer applications diploma desirable.
  • Senior Scientific Officer (Physics): Ph.D. in Physics with 5 years’ teaching/research experience (excluding Ph.D.) OR M.Sc. in Physics with 8 years’ teaching/research experience; educational innovation, course design, lab development and computer knowledge desirable.
  • Scientific Officer (Physics): Ph.D. in Physics with 3 years’ teaching/research experience (excluding Ph.D.) OR M.Sc. in Physics with 7 years’ teaching/research experience.
  • Electronics Engineer (Electronics Engineering): B.Tech (Electronics) or equivalent with 1 year experience in relevant field; experience in electronics circuits & systems, microcomputers, microprocessors, digital systems, modern instrumentation desirable.
  • Mechanical Engineer (Physics): B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 1 year relevant experience; experience in designing and repairing laboratory equipment desirable.
  • Assistant Nursing Superintendent (J.N. Medical College Hospital): Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, registration as Nurse and Midwife with State Council, 5 years’ experience as Ward Sister; computer knowledge desirable.
  • Casualty Medical Officer (J.N. Medical College Hospital): MBBS plus PG degree/diploma in clinical subject with 1 year experience as Resident/Registrar in a teaching hospital; casualty and medico-legal work experience and computer knowledge desirable.
  • Medical Officer (Blood Bank) (J.N. Medical College Hospital): MBBS with PG degree in Pathology and 1 year Blood Transfusion Officer experience or 3 years in Blood Bank of teaching hospital, OR MBBS with 5 years as Blood Transfusion Officer/5 years Blood Bank experience; Blood Transfusion training and computer knowledge desirable.
  • Medical Officer (Modern Trauma Centre): MBBS with PG degree/diploma in clinical subject and 1 year Resident/Registrar experience; MD/MS in General Surgery/Orthopedics/Anaesthesiology/Medicine, trauma and casualty experience desirable.
  • Deputy Nursing Superintendent (Modern Trauma Centre): Registered Nurse and Midwife, Diploma in Nursing Education & Administration / B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic Nursing degree with 5 years’ experience as Ward Sister; computer knowledge and experience as Deputy Nursing Superintendent/ANS in 500+ bed hospital desirable.
  • University Health Officer (University Health Office): MBBS or equivalent medical qualification with minimum 3 years’ experience in Public Health Administration; PG Diploma/Degree in Public Health desirable.

Important Instructions

  • Separate online application forms must be filled for each post; fee is charged per application.
  • All uploaded and attached documents must be self-attested.
  • Hardcopy submission is compulsory; online-only applications will not be considered.
  • Serving candidates must apply through proper channel and submit NOC.
  • Eligibility (qualification and experience) will be counted as on the last date for online application.
  • 5% marks relaxation at Bachelor’s and Master’s level is applicable for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and PwD candidates for eligibility.
  • The University may verify the recognition status of institutions/hospitals at any stage and can cancel candidature accordingly.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • No correspondence will be entertained with candidates who are not shortlisted.
  • The University reserves the right to modify or cancel the recruitment process at any stage.

Selection Process

  • Scrutiny and shortlisting of applications based on essential qualifications and experience.
  • Written test of 100 marks may be held if the number of applications is large; shortlisting may be done in approximately 1:5 ratio.
  • Interview of shortlisted candidates.
  • Final selection will be based on merit and performance in interview, followed by document verification.
  • The University is not bound to call every eligible candidate for interview.

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:
    • Full name, father's name, date of birth
    • Current and permanent residential addresses with PIN codes
    • Email address and mobile number
    • Details of posts held under the Government (designation, pay scale, duration, retirement date)
    • Educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, LL.B., and any other qualifications)
    • Whether previously worked as SJM/SMM with year-wise details and annual confidential report percentages
  5. Mention whether any criminal case is pending or FIR lodged
  6. Sign the declaration that all information provided is correct

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

  • Photocopies of all relevant documents mentioned in the application
  • Character roll entries of the last 5 years of Government service (if applicable)
  • Law degree certificate and other educational qualification certificates
  • Copy of Gazette notification of Government service record
  • For ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment: Four best judgments delivered as SJM/SMM
  • Annual Confidential Reports (ACR) for the last 5 years (if available)
  • Self-attested photograph (4x6 cm)

Submission Mode

  1. Applicants must submit their applications OFFLINE directly to the respective District Judge of the district for which they are applying
  2. Do NOT send applications directly to the High Court — applications sent directly to High Court will be rejected
  3. Submit to the following District Judges based on your choice:
    • For Gonda: District Judge, Gonda District Court
    • For Jalaun: District Judge, Jalaun District Court
  4. Ensure all documents are complete and properly organized
  5. Keep a copy of submitted application for reference
